title: URGENT HIRING | HR MANAGER / SENIOR MANAGER – HUMAN RESOURCES
description:
**Location:** Bommasandra, Bengaluru, Karnataka  
**Experience:** 7–12 Years  
**Industry:** Manufacturing / Industrial  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Department:** Human Resources \& Administration

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and result\-oriented **HR Manager / Senior Manager – Human Resources** to lead and manage the complete HR function at our manufacturing plant in Bommasandra, Bengaluru.

The ideal candidate must have substantial hands\-on experience in **factory HR operations, Industrial Relations (IR), labour law compliance, union handling, contract labour management and workforce administration**.

This role requires a strong HR professional who understands the complexities of a manufacturing environment, can effectively manage workmen and staff, maintain harmonious industrial relations, and ensure smooth plant operations through effective people management and statutory compliance.

**Candidates with a strong manufacturing plant HR background and practical experience in handling labour\-related matters are strongly preferred. Candidates must be currently based in Bengaluru.**

Key Responsibilities1\. Manufacturing Plant HR Operations

* Manage the complete HR function and day\-to\-day HR operations of the manufacturing plant.
* Handle manpower planning, workforce budgeting, recruitment and deployment for workmen, contract labour, supervisors, engineers and managerial staff.
* Ensure adequate manpower availability to support production requirements and uninterrupted plant operations.
* Coordinate closely with Production, Stores, Maintenance, Finance, Security and other departments.
* Manage shift\-related HR activities, attendance, absenteeism, leave administration and workforce discipline.
* Develop and implement HR policies, procedures and systems suitable for a manufacturing environment.

2\. Industrial Relations (IR), Labour \& Union Management

* Independently handle Industrial Relations and employee relations matters at the factory.
* Manage relationships with workmen, labour representatives, union leaders and other relevant stakeholders.
* Handle union\-related matters, worker grievances, disciplinary issues, domestic enquiries and conflict resolution.
* Participate in discussions and negotiations with labour unions and employee representatives, including wage\-related matters and settlement discussions, as applicable.
* Maintain harmonious industrial relations and address workforce concerns proactively.
* Handle misconduct, absenteeism, indiscipline, disputes and other labour\-related issues in accordance with applicable laws and company policies.
* Support management in managing sensitive employee relations matters and maintaining workplace discipline.
* Monitor workforce morale and identify potential employee relations issues before they escalate.

3\. Labour Law \& Statutory Compliance

* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws, statutory requirements and government regulations relevant to the manufacturing establishment.
* Manage statutory compliances relating to PF, ESIC, gratuity, bonus, wages, contract labour, working hours, leave, overtime and other applicable employment requirements.
* Oversee factory\-related labour documentation, statutory registers, returns, notices and records.
* Coordinate statutory inspections, labour audits and visits by government authorities.
* Liaise with labour department officials, statutory authorities, consultants and other external stakeholders as required.
* Ensure timely renewal and maintenance of applicable registrations, licences and statutory records.
* Keep management informed about relevant changes in labour legislation and compliance requirements.

4\. Contract Labour \& Workforce Administration

* Manage contract labour deployment, attendance, documentation and compliance.
* Coordinate with contractors regarding manpower availability, wage payments, statutory contributions and other contractual obligations.
* Verify contractor compliance documentation and address discrepancies in consultation with relevant departments.
* Monitor contract labour strength, overtime, absenteeism and workforce productivity.
* Ensure proper onboarding, induction, safety coordination and documentation for contract and permanent employees.
* Handle labour\-related concerns involving contractors and outsourced manpower.

5\. Recruitment \& Manpower Planning

* Drive end\-to\-end recruitment for plant\-level and managerial positions.
* Develop manpower plans in coordination with department heads and production requirements.
* Manage sourcing, screening, interviews, selection, salary negotiations and joining formalities.
* Ensure timely closure of critical vacancies and maintain an effective recruitment pipeline.
* Monitor employee turnover, absenteeism and manpower gaps, and recommend suitable corrective actions.

6\. Performance Management, Training \& Employee Engagement

* Implement performance appraisal and employee development processes.
* Coordinate training, skill development, induction and capability\-building initiatives.
* Drive employee engagement, welfare activities and initiatives to improve workforce morale.
* Support supervisors and department heads in people management and performance\-related matters.
* Identify training needs and promote a culture of discipline, productivity and continuous improvement.

7\. Payroll, HR Administration \& MIS

* Oversee attendance, leave management, overtime calculations and payroll coordination.
* Ensure accurate maintenance of employee records, personal files and HR documentation.
* Manage onboarding, confirmation, transfers, promotions, separation, exit formalities and full \& final settlements.
* Prepare and review HR MIS reports covering manpower, recruitment, attrition, absenteeism, overtime, labour costs and statutory compliance.
* Provide regular HR updates, analysis and recommendations to senior management.
* Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of employee information and HR records.

8\. HR Strategy \& Management Support

* Advise management on employee relations, manpower requirements, workforce discipline and HR policies.
* Identify opportunities for improving HR processes, workforce productivity and cost efficiency.
* Support organisational development, succession planning and employee retention initiatives.
* Work closely with plant leadership to align HR activities with production, operational and business objectives.

Required Qualifications \& Experience

* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources or equivalent qualification.
* **7–12 years of relevant HR experience, with mandatory hands\-on experience in a manufacturing plant.**
* Strong practical experience in Industrial Relations, labour management, union handling and employee grievance resolution.
* Thorough knowledge of applicable labour laws and statutory compliance requirements.
* Experience managing permanent workmen, contract labour, staff and supervisory employees.
* Proven exposure to factory HR operations, workforce discipline, contractor management and labour\-related matters.
* Good understanding of payroll coordination, attendance management, manpower planning and HR administration.
* Proficiency in MS Office, Excel and HRMS / ERP systems.
* Strong communication, negotiation, leadership and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to independently manage HR responsibilities in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* **Must be currently based in Bengaluru.**
* Candidates with experience in industrial, engineering, packaging, metal, automotive or other manufacturing sectors will be preferred.
* Experience handling a sizeable factory workforce and complex employee relations matters.
* Exposure to unionised environments, wage settlements, labour negotiations and domestic enquiries will be an advantage.
* Ability to work closely with plant management and provide practical, business\-oriented HR solutions.
* A proactive, approachable and firm approach to workforce management, employee discipline and compliance.

title: Senior Product Manager - Recruiter Experience (India)
description:
**We're** **Karat****, the world's largest interviewing company.**
------------------------------------------------------------------


Karat is transforming organizations around the world. We provide a powerful system for technical leaders at companies like PayPal, Atlassian, and Citi who want to take control of how they hire top engineers, elevate their teams and contractors, and stay ahead. At the core of Karat’s system are live, expert\-led interviews, analytics designed to give leaders maximum visibility, and the most robust interview performance dataset in the world.


**Come join our** **Product** **team**
--------------------------------------


Our Product team is committed to driving forward Karat’s mission to make interviews predictive, fair, and enjoyable. We are focused on providing deeper value to engineering and talent leaders, hiring managers, recruiters, candidates, and Interview Engineers.


### **What you will do**


As Senior Product Manager, you will own the product vision, strategy, and execution for recruiter experience within the Karat Platform. You'll build experiences that give recruiters clearer visibility into their pipeline, faster ways to act on it, and less manual overhead — including exciting new ground in how strong candidates get matched to the right opportunity, not just the role they originally applied for. You'll collaborate across engineering, content, design, and go\-to\-market teams to deliver high\-impact solutions for our recruiting customers.


**This position requires a schedule that overlaps with U.S. business hours.**


* **Product Strategy \& Innovation:** Define the roadmap for the recruiter\-facing workflow and analytics experience; identify where better tooling, automation, and insight can save recruiters time and improve their day\-to\-day decision\-making; explore new ways to surface and route strong candidates toward better\-fit opportunities, both within a single hiring pipeline and across the broader set of roles we help fill.
* **Product Development \& Execution:** Prioritize features based on customer needs and business objectives; partner with engineering, content, and UX teams to deliver high\-quality, enterprise\-ready solutions, including integrations with customers' existing recruiting systems
* **Analytics \& Insights:** Design and refine the dashboards and reporting recruiters rely on to manage their workload; analyze usage data to understand where recruiters get stuck or drop out of a workflow; run experiments to test new ways of surfacing insight, reducing manual effort, and improving match quality between candidates and opportunities
* **Market \& Customer Focus:** Track performance metrics and identify improvement opportunities; partner with Go\-to\-Market teams on expansion strategies; build compelling business cases for new offerings, including entirely new ways of connecting candidates to opportunity.

### **The experience you will bring**

description:
**We're** **Karat****, the world's largest interviewing company.**
------------------------------------------------------------------



Karat is transforming organizations around the world. We provide a powerful system for technical leaders at companies like PayPal, Atlassian, and Citi who want to take control of how they hire top engineers, elevate their teams and contractors, and stay ahead. At the core of Karat's system are live, expert\-led interviews, analytics designed to give leaders maximum visibility, and the most robust interview performance dataset in the world.

**Come join our** **Product** **team**
--------------------------------------



Our Product team is committed to driving forward Karat's mission to make interviews predictive, fair, and enjoyable. We are focused on providing deeper value to engineering and talent leaders, hiring managers, recruiters, candidates, and Interview Engineers.


### **What you will do**



As Senior Product Manager, you will own the product vision, strategy, and execution for recruiter experience within the Karat Platform. You'll build experiences that give recruiters clearer visibility into their pipeline, faster ways to act on it, and less manual overhead — including exciting new ground in how strong candidates get matched to the right opportunity, not just the role they originally applied for. You'll collaborate across engineering, content, design, and go\-to\-market teams to deliver high\-impact solutions for our recruiting customers.


**This position requires a schedule that overlaps with U.S. business hours.**


* **Product Strategy \& Innovation:** Define the roadmap for the recruiter\-facing workflow and analytics experience; identify where better tooling, automation, and insight can save recruiters time and improve their day\-to\-day decision\-making; explore new ways to surface and route strong candidates toward better\-fit opportunities, both within a single hiring pipeline and across the broader set of roles we help fill.
* **Product Development \& Execution:** Prioritize features based on customer needs and business objectives; partner with engineering, content, and UX teams to deliver high\-quality, enterprise\-ready solutions, including integrations with customers' existing recruiting systems
* **Analytics \& Insights:** Design and refine the dashboards and reporting recruiters rely on to manage their workload; analyze usage data to understand where recruiters get stuck or drop out of a workflow; run experiments to test new ways of surfacing insight, reducing manual effort, and improving match quality between candidates and opportunities
* **Market \& Customer Focus:** Track performance metrics and identify improvement opportunities; partner with Go\-to\-Market teams on expansion strategies; build compelling business cases for new offerings, including entirely new ways of connecting candidates to opportunity.

### **The experience you will bring**


* 5\+ years of product management experience across B2B and B2C offerings, ideally with exposure to recruiting, HR tech, or matching/marketplace\-style products
* Genuine passion for and track record of building B2B SaaS applications — comfortable running customer discovery calls and QBRs and translating enterprise feedback directly into product decisions
* Demonstrated experience designing analytics, dashboards, or workflow tools that measurably improved how a professional user did their job
* Excited by greenfield, 0\-to\-1 problems — this role includes building something genuinely new, not just optimizing what exists
* Comfortable holding your own in client meetings with recruiting and TA leaders at large enterprises
* Excellent communication skills; able to translate complex concepts for diverse stakeholders and lead cross\-functional teams

title: GB/G Master Data Analyst
description:
**LOCATION**


Hyderabad, IND  

  

**COMPANY**


BASF Global Business Services Private Limited

  

  

**JOB FIELD**


Finance, Controlling \& Audit

  

  

  

  

**JOB TYPE**


Permanent

  

  

  

**JOB ID**


144549

  

  

  

  

**FLEXIBLE WORK OPTIONS**


On\-site


  
**BASF Overview**
  

BASF has successfully partnered India’s progress for more than 130 years. As of the end of 2025, BASF had 2,455 employees in India with 8 production sites and 45 offices throughout the country. The Innovation Campus Mumbai and the Coatings Technical Center in Mangalore are both part of BASF’s global technology platform. In 2025, BASF registered sales of approximately €2\.2 billion to customers in India. Further information is available on www.basf.com/in


**About the Role**
  

The Semi\-Senior Master Data Business Partner Analyst controls and audits the accurate creation and modification of customer, supplier, and bank master data for the LATAM and North America regions within agreed service\-level timelines. The role supports stakeholders, maintains strong customer focus, helps prevent fraud exposure, identifies process deviations, and contributes to local, regional, and global initiatives.


**What's In It for You**
  

* Be part of building BASF's new Global Hub in India, a flagship transformation initiative


* Work with a globally integrated team spanning Finance and HR functions


* Competitive compensation, benefits, and structured career pathways


* Access to BASF's world\-class learning \& development programs


* Inclusive, diverse, and collaborative work culture


* Hybrid work model (mix of on\-site and remote)


**Key Responsibilities**
  

* Validate, audit, and perform quality checks on customer, supplier, and bank master data for creation and modification requests in accordance with internal policies and procedures.


* Help prevent potential fraud exposure by confirming that master\-data requests meet applicable control, approval, and documentation requirements.


* Execute mass\-change requests in compliance with internal policies and procedures.


* Serve as the point of contact for project teams when initiatives may affect the Master Data area.


* Maintain clear and proactive communication with stakeholders, global Master Data representatives, and other company functions to improve the user experience.


* Prepare presentations and reports, perform testing and duplicate analysis, maintain documentation, handle ad hoc requests, and deliver user training.


* Identify process deviations and improvement opportunities, communicate them promptly, and propose practical solutions.


* Respond to inquiries, provide reports and analyses, and follow up on local, regional, or global initiatives with support from the FEX, Team Coordinator, and Manager.


**Minimum Qualifications**
  

* **Education:** Professional qualification in Finance (e.g. B com, CA, CPA, etc.) or MBA or Master degree in finance / Accounting or related disciplines


* **Work Experience:** 3\-5 years of experience in master\-data maintenance, procurement, credit, finance operations, or a related field.


* **Process Knowledge:** Solid understanding of customer, supplier, and bank master\-data creation and maintenance, data\-quality controls, duplicate analysis, service\-level requirements, internal procedures, and fraud\-risk prevention.


* **Decision\-Making:** Tasks and responsibilities are completed under close guidance or alignment with the team lead.


* **Leadership:** No formal leadership experience is required.


* **Project Experience:** Formal project experience is not required, although the role serves as a contact for initiatives affecting the Master Data area.


* **Core Skills:** Teamwork, effective communication, customer focus, problem\-solving, attention to detail, autonomy, organization, and stakeholder coordination.


**Technical Skills**
  

* Intermediate proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.


* Intermediate working knowledge of SAP.


* Advanced Spanish and intermediate English and/or Portuguese proficiency are required for the regional scope described in the source JD.


* Experience with customer, supplier, and bank master\-data processes is preferred.


* Ability to prepare reports and presentations, perform testing and duplicate analysis, and maintain process documentation.


* Experience in a shared services, multinational, or GCC environment is preferred.

title: Manager-Talent Consultant
description:
Location: Bengaluru
Other locations: Primary Location Only
Salary: Competitive
Date: 21 Sept 2026
**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1743167
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**Talent Consultant\- Manager**



If you are looking for a challenging and rewarding career experience as a Talent Consultant in a high\-growth organization, we have a role here. At EY GDS we value wellbeing, curiosity and agility as an individual. We create teams of inspiring, teaming and belonging. We care for our business, society and client. Our purpose is building a better working world. Does that resonate with you? We look forward to working with you.

  


**The opportunity**



You will be responsible for supporting the Talent agenda for a business unit (GDS Operations) in EY GDS and will be the key point of contact for leadership on a range of talent related matters. You will drive and implement the engagement agenda, work closely with other members of the team to providing change leadership, increase workforce capability and talent management. You will build a deep understanding of business unit direction and Talent related topics/issues to ensure successful implementation of key projects and processes.

  



You will need to be collaborative, influential and work across functions to execute on attracting, assimilating, developing, engaging and retaining key talent. You will drive project management for various HR initiatives, including Workforce Planning, Performance Management, Talent transformation, Talent Development and Reward \& Recognition etc.

  


**Your key responsibilities**


* Support the Strategic Talent Consultant in designing a sustainable and scalable engagement framework for the business unit and take ownership for the delivery
* Provide support to the business leaders and counsellors in the implementation of engagement initiatives across the business unit
* Responsible for building, developing and managing other members of the talent consulting team, ensuring continued focus on the talent agenda
* Anticipate issues and needs within the business unit and address these effectively
* Act as a coach to business leader/managers in relation to delivering the people strategy agenda
* Provide insight on people issues, particularly ER cases within business unit, provide a robust point of view on business decisions and their impact upon people
* Ensure that all necessary people management and development activity required to support the business unit is delivered in the most professional and effective manner
* Execute innovative HR programs
* Facilitate change and support the implementation and successful adoption of special projects and initiatives in the business unit, for example: Performance Management, Talent transformation, Talent Development and Reward exercises
* Ensure compliance to local regulations and manage risks (e.g. performance management risk)

  


**Skills and attributes for success**


* Strong business acumen and commercial awareness, ability to develop clear, actionable plans in support of an overall business unit strategy
* Strong client focus with the ability to build good relationships with multiple stakeholders across the organisation at all levels
* Strong Employee Relations experience of complex disciplinary, grievance and performance management activities, especially with employees in senior management/leadership level
* Develop strong relationship with other Talent Centre of Excellence teams to ensure that centrally developed products and initiatives meet the requirements of the business unit
* Ability to work with ambiguity and build consensus across diverse, often global, groups

  


**To qualify for the role, you must have**


* Graduate or a post graduate qualification in a Business or Human Resource discipline is desirable.
* 8 \-12 years of proven HR generalist experience (e.g. performance management, employee relations)
* Experience in managing and mentoring teams

  


**Ideally, you’ll also have**


* A professional accreditation or HR specialization certification
* Experience working in a consulting organization or in a similar professional services environment
* Experience of working in a cross\-border, virtual environment would be beneficial

  


**What we look for**


* Be an enabler of high\-performance Talent team.
* Keen interest to invest time for self\-learning, seeking opportunities to work on cross\-functional HR projects
* Working collaboratively in a team environment
* A self\-starter, independent\-thinker, curious and creative person with desire and passion

  


**What we offer**



EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.


* **Continuous learning:**You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success as defined by you****:** We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership****:** We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:**You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

  



About EY


**EY \| Building a better working world**

  



EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  



 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

title: HR Executive
description:
**About the Role**

Cokonet Academy is looking for an enthusiastic and organized **HR Executive with approximately 1 year of HR experience**.

This is a generalist HR role providing hands\-on exposure to **Recruitment, Onboarding, HR Operations, Employee Engagement, Performance Management and Learning \& Development**.

We are looking for someone who wants to build a long\-term career in HR rather than work only in recruitment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Source and screen candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, referrals and other channels.
* Coordinate interviews with hiring managers.
* Maintain recruitment pipelines and trackers.
* Follow up with candidates from selection through joining.
* Prepare and coordinate offer letters, appointment letters and employee documentation.
* Manage joining formalities and employee onboarding.
* Maintain employee records, attendance and leave information.
* Coordinate payroll inputs with Finance.
* Maintain HR reports, trackers and dashboards.
* Support probation and confirmation processes.
* Coordinate employee engagement activities, celebrations and recognition programs.
* Support performance\-review and KPI/scorecard processes.
* Coordinate employee training and development activities.
* Assist with PF, ESI, POSH and other HR compliance requirements.
* Support employee exit formalities.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee and company information.

**What We Are Looking For**

* MBA/PGDM in HR, MSW\-HR or another relevant HR qualification preferred.
* **1\-2 years of HR experience**, preferably covering both recruitment and HR operations.
* Good understanding of basic HR processes.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Good interpersonal and people\-coordination skills.
* Strong follow\-up and organizational ability.
* Working knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets.
* Comfortable learning HR software, digital tools and AI\-enabled workplace tools.
* Good English and Malayalam communication.
* High level of integrity and confidentiality.
* Ability to take ownership and complete tasks within timelines.

**Preferred Skills**

Experience or exposure to **recruitment, onboarding, attendance management, employee engagement, HR documentation, payroll coordination or performance management** will be an advantage.

**Why Join Cokonet?**

This is not intended to be a recruitment\-only position. You will get exposure across the employee lifecycle and have the opportunity to develop into a well\-rounded HR professional.

Strong performers can progress toward **Senior HR Executive, HR Generalist and future HR leadership roles** as the organization grows.

**If you have around one year of HR experience, enjoy working with people and want a role where you can learn, take ownership and grow, we'd like to hear from you.**

Pay: ₹12,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Experience:

* Work: 1 year (Required)

Language:

* English fluently (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: HR Shared Services Specialist (Temp)
description:
Overview:

Waters Corporation's HR Service Delivery Centre supports approximately 16,000 employees globally. The HRSDC Specialist is a Tier 1 generalist role and the primary human point of contact for employees and managers whose issue the virtual agent or Knowledge Base could not resolve. This is a volume\-driven role: breadth of case type across the full employee lifecycle, is what the role optimises for.  

HRSDC's service catalogue will keep expanding as the HR org design and RACI analysis work progresses, and Specialists at this level will take on additional service categories from various HR Centres of Excellence over time. Each new addition will be onboarded once the underlying process has been streamlined, globalised, and standardised, so HRSDC takes on genuine shared\-service work.
Responsibilities:
**Employee Lifecycle \& Onboarding*** Own end\-to\-end written offer delivery via iCIMS following verbal offer discussion and confirmation by Talent Acquisition or the HR Generalist — HRSDC is the designated party for written offer issuance under the current TA/HR Generalist role split; field candidate questions on offer terms and escalate genuine negotiation back to TA/HR Generalist
* Own the pre\-employment background check process end\-to\-end: initiate checks with the background check vendor upon offer acceptance, track status to clearance, resolve standard discrepancies directly, and manage adverse\-finding escalations per policy
* Partner with new hires and the background check vendor to ensure required onboarding forms and Form I\-9 documentation (USA) are completed, accurate, and filed within statutory timelines
* Release new\-hire onboarding tasks and oversee new\-hire system setup in SF Employee Central once background check clearance is confirmed and new hire information form is completed; manage exceptions across new hires, hiring manager and relevant HR teams (e.g., contingent starts, delayed clearance) per policy
* Partner with people leaders to ensure all standard employee data changes in SF EC are performed — promotions, transfers, job\-code changes, leaves of absence, and position management updates — following the job/comp change model and backdate rules
* Coordinate the global offboarding process: execute offboarding checklists, ensure to educate line manager of employee’s systems exits, generate resignation letters where applicable
* Support BD conveyed employee onboarding: process standard system access requests per the onboarding matrix, handle FAQ inquiries, and flag exceptions to the senior HRSDC team

 **Benefits, Payroll \& Total Rewards Support*** Handle time and attendance queries; escalate genuine payroll\-impact discrepancies to the Payroll CoE with a clear case summary
* Manage standard salary and pay changes within approved guidelines: validate manager approval and process in SF EC; flag abnormal changes to management immediately
* Manage pay transparency requests: provide own\-job\-code range per the documented Waters rule; redirect other\-job\-code requests using the standard script

 **HR Data, Case Management \& Digital Execution*** Manage case intake and resolution in the SNOW HRSD queue: triage accurately, categorise correctly, and resolve at Tier 1 wherever a documented KBA or SOP exists
* Process employment verification letters and custom HR support letters (visa, mortgage, immigration) within HRSDC scope
* Author and maintain KBAs in ServiceNow for recurring case types; submit new KBAs to HR Knowledge Management function for review before publication
* Use Now Assist copilot tools to draft standard communications, summarise ticket requests, and maintain throughput without sacrificing quality
* Meet all SLA and quality benchmarks consistently; self\-monitor against team dashboard; raise queue health concerns proactively


Qualifications:
**What You Bring — Essential*** Experience in an HR Shared Services, Service Delivery, or HR case\-management environment — typically 1\-2 years
* Hands\-on HCM (such as SF Employee Central) experience: you can execute data changes, read field\-level validation rules, and distinguish a configuration issue from a user error
* Working knowledge of a case management or ticketing system — ServiceNow HRSD experience is a strong advantage
* Strong written English: the role requires clear, professional communication with employees and managers across multiple time zones
* Able to apply documented policies to real situations with independent judgement — not a task\-executor waiting for instructions on every edge case

**What You Bring — Desirable*** Familiarity with DocuSign or equivalent e\-signature tooling
* Exposure to AI\-assisted case management tools — EmployeeWorks, Now Assist, or similar
* Experience supporting an HR system go\-live or post\-merger integration


Company Description:

Waters Corporation (NYSE:WAT) is a global leader in life sciences and diagnostics, dedicated to accelerating the benefits of pioneering science through analytical technologies, informatics, and service. With a focus on regulated, high\-volume testing environments, our innovative portfolio harnesses deep scientific expertise across chemistry, physics, and biology. We collaborate with customers around the world to advance the release of effective, high\-quality medicines, ensure the safety of food and water, and drive better patient outcomes by detecting diseases earlier, managing routine infections, and combating antibiotic resistance. Through a shared culture of relentless innovation, our passionate team of \~16,000 colleagues turn scientific challenges into breakthroughs that improve lives worldwide. *Diversity and inclusion are fundamental to our core values at Waters Corporation. It benefits our employees, our products, our customers and our community. Waters complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws. Qualified applicants are considered without regard to sex, race, color, ancestry, national origin, citizenship status, religion, age, marital status (including civil unions), military service, veteran status, pregnancy (including childbirth and related medical conditions), genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, legally recognized disability, domestic violence victim status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Waters is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. All hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.*

* Process employment verification letters and custom HR support letters (visa, mortgage, immigration) within HRSDC scope
* Author and maintain KBAs in ServiceNow for recurring case types; submit new KBAs to HR Knowledge Management function for review before publication
* Use Now Assist copilot tools to draft standard communications, summarise ticket requests, and maintain throughput without sacrificing quality
* Meet all SLA and quality benchmarks consistently; self\-monitor against team dashboard; raise queue health concerns proactively

**What You Bring — Essential*** Experience in an HR Shared Services, Service Delivery, or HR case\-management environment — typically 1\-2 years

* Working knowledge of a case management or ticketing system — ServiceNow HRSD experience is a strong advantage
* Strong written English: the role requires clear, professional communication with employees and managers across multiple time zones
* Able to apply documented policies to real situations with independent judgement — not a task\-executor waiting for instructions on every edge case

title: Human Resource Executive
description:
HR Executive / HR Manager

**Department:** Human Resources  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Location:** \[Location / Hybrid / Remote]  
**Experience:** 0–2 years  
**Reports To:** Management / HR Head

**About the Role**

We are looking for a motivated and people\-oriented **HR professional** to join our growing software company. The HR will be responsible for managing day\-to\-day HR operations, recruitment, employee engagement, onboarding, performance management, HR policies, and employee relations.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in a fast\-paced technology environment and should be able to work closely with management, technical teams, and employees.

**Key ResponsibilitiesRecruitment \& Hiring**

* Manage the complete recruitment cycle from job requirement to employee joining.
* Understand hiring requirements from technical and non\-technical teams.
* Prepare and publish job descriptions on relevant job portals and recruitment platforms.
* Source and screen candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, referrals, and other channels.
* Conduct initial HR interviews and coordinate technical/management interviews.
* Manage salary discussions, offer letters, and joining formalities.
* Maintain an active talent pipeline for future requirements.
* Build a positive candidate experience throughout the hiring process.

**Employee Onboarding**

* Manage joining formalities and employee documentation.
* Conduct employee induction and orientation programs.
* Introduce new employees to company policies, culture, teams, and processes.
* Coordinate with IT and administration teams to ensure employees receive required access and equipment.
* Ensure employee records are accurately maintained.

**HR Operations**

* Maintain employee records, attendance, leave, and personnel files.
* Manage HR documentation and HRMS/database updates.
* Prepare HR reports related to headcount, attendance, recruitment, attrition, and employee status.
* Coordinate with finance/payroll teams for monthly payroll inputs.
* Maintain and communicate HR policies and procedures.
* Handle employee queries related to HR policies, leave, attendance, benefits, and other HR matters.

**Employee Engagement \& Relations**

* Maintain positive relationships with employees and management.
* Address employee concerns and grievances professionally and confidentially.
* Organize employee engagement activities, celebrations, team events, and recognition programs.
* Conduct employee feedback and satisfaction initiatives.
* Help promote a positive and collaborative workplace culture.

**Performance Management**

* Coordinate employee performance review and appraisal processes.
* Assist managers in setting employee goals and performance expectations.
* Track performance review schedules and documentation.
* Support managers in handling performance\-related concerns.
* Assist in developing employee career\-development and training initiatives.

**Learning \& Development**

* Identify employee training requirements.
* Coordinate internal and external training programs.
* Maintain training records and evaluate training effectiveness.
* Support employee development and career\-growth initiatives.

**HR Policies \& Compliance**

* Implement and maintain company HR policies and procedures.
* Ensure HR practices follow applicable employment laws and statutory requirements.
* Maintain required employee documentation and records.
* Assist management with disciplinary procedures when required.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee and company information.

**Exit Management**

* Manage resignation and employee exit procedures.
* Conduct exit interviews and document employee feedback.
* Coordinate clearance and handover processes.
* Ensure exit documentation and final HR formalities are completed.
* Analyze employee attrition and identify recurring issues.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* MBA/PGDM in HR is preferred.
* 0–2 years of HR experience, preferably in a software, IT, SaaS, or technology company.
* Good understanding of recruitment and HR operations.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good knowledge of MS Office/Google Workspace and HRMS tools.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive employee matters.
* Strong organizational and problem\-solving skills.

Preferred Skills

* Experience recruiting software developers, QA engineers, DevOps engineers, UI/UX professionals, and other technology roles.
* Experience working in a startup or fast\-growing software company.
* Knowledge of HR analytics and reporting.
* Familiarity with payroll and attendance systems.
* Knowledge of applicable employment and statutory requirements.
* Strong interviewing and candidate\-screening skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.

Key Performance Indicators

The HR professional will be expected to contribute toward:

* Timely closure of open positions
* Quality of new hires
* Employee retention
* Employee engagement
* Effective onboarding
* Accurate HR records and documentation
* Timely completion of performance reviews
* Employee grievance resolution
* HR process efficiency
* Compliance with company policies and applicable regulations

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is:

* **People\-oriented**
* **Approachable and professional**
* **Highly organized**
* **Proactive and responsible**
* **Strong in communication**
* **Good at problem\-solving**
* **Confidential and trustworthy**
* **Comfortable working in a fast\-paced technology environment**
* **Able to balance employee needs with business requirements**

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary
* Growth and career\-development opportunities
* Collaborative and technology\-driven work environment
* Learning and training opportunities
* Employee engagement activities
* Flexible/hybrid working options, where applicable
* Opportunity to contribute to and build HR processes in a growing software company

**About TechMET Works Private Limited**

TechMET Works Private Limited is a growing software/technology company focused on building innovative technology solutions for our customers. We believe our people are central to our success and are committed to creating a professional, collaborative, and growth\-oriented workplace.

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

Key areas of focus include leadership coaching, workforce planning, change management, employee relations, HR compliance, and the execution of strategic HR initiatives.


Working closely with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, Talent, and Legal, the HR Leader will lead key HR programs, represent HR in leadership forums, and ensure the effective delivery of integrated HR solutions that support business objectives.


The successful candidate will demonstrate strong business acumen, sound judgment, and exceptional coaching, influencing, and relationship\-building skills. Leveraging data\-driven insights and practical HR solutions, they will guide leadership decision\-making, drive alignment, and support business priorities.


Success in this role requires the ability to operate effectively within a complex, matrixed global environment and to proactively engage and influence stakeholders to achieve meaningful business and people outcomes.


We value multiple backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, recognizing that they strengthen our teams and enhance our ability to support a global workforce.

* Operate effectively in a fast\-paced, global environment.

* Design and implement HR policies and procedures to ensure compliance and engagement.

description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**

  

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

 **People, Governance \& Communications :**

  

This team leads the implementation of the Group’s people strategy in line with our business objectives. It facilitates talent management, succession planning, and employee mobility while defining and overseeing frameworks that support employee performance management, reward, learning and development, resourcing and engagement.

 **Job Description:**

 **Why join us?**

* The Human Resources (HR) team supports the people strategy by providing expert advice and guidance on the development, implementation, and ongoing review of key HR programmes and policies.

 **The Opportunity:**

* The incumbent will be responsible for working to support the delivery of the team’s strategic priorities and managing the overall agenda for their client groups to enable business performance.
* This includes providing support on recognition, global mobility, employee benefits, wellbeing, vendor management, reporting to support the Bank’s strategic objectives and local business priorities.

 **What you’ll do:**

* Liaise with colleagues from across the organization to support priorities related to recognition, global mobility, employee benefits, wellbeing, vendor management and reporting
* Work with internal colleagues and vendors and suppliers to ensure the successful implementation of initiatives, processes and products in line with business objectives
* Develop specialist knowledge by keeping abreast of internal policies, competitor practice, external market developments and trends, and legislative and regulatory developments
* Translate data and reporting into analysis by interpreting the data and providing insights

 **Qualifications**

* Graduate degree

 **What you will need to succeed in the role:**

* Effectively managing stakeholders and ensuring appropriate alignment between local and global practices and requirements
* Managing multiple priorities and adherence to timelines while dealing with ambiguity and navigating complex processes
* Highly proactive, ability to work in a matrix environment including colleagues in global, regional and country teams

**What additional skills will be good to have?**

* Strong collaboration skills with the ability to engage a diverse stakeholder group, including senior populations
* Strong track record of analytical skills, ability to interpret and to draw insights from data and present effectively to stakeholders
* Strong business acumen with ability to apply critical analysis and judgment when reviewing activities

  

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision\-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.

 **Additional Notes :** Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools is an advantage.

 **Additional Information**The tenure of the Apprentice will be 1 (one) year as defined under Apprentices Act, 1961 and Apprenticeship Rules 1992 amended from time to time.All Apprentices engaged by the Bank will also be featured in NATS portal as an ‘Apprentice’. By virtue of them being covered under the provisions of the Act, a candidate profile will be created for each apprentice in the NATS portal, which will be available to them for viewing.On completion of the one\-year Apprenticeship tenure, a Certificate of Proficiency will be issued to the apprentice by the Govt. of India, as applicable under the Act and the enrollment under the Apprenticeship Act will cease.All other clauses regarding the tenure of engagement as an Apprentice with HSBC will stand as mentioned in the offer letter issued by the Bank at the time of joining.

  

You’ll achieve more at HSBC.


HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

  

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: HR Executive
description:
**Position:** HR Executive  

**Department:** Human Resources  

**Location:** Bengaluru  

**Experience:** 2–5 Years  

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time


share me Your CV to hr@envigaurd.com


### **Job Summary**


We are looking for an organized and proactive **HR Executive** to manage day\-to\-day HR operations, recruitment, employee coordination, documentation, attendance, payroll support, and employee engagement activities.


### **Key Responsibilities**


**1\. Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition**


* Manage the complete recruitment process from sourcing to onboarding.
* Coordinate with candidates for interviews, follow\-ups, salary discussions, and joining formalities.
* Source candidates through job portals, recruitment consultants, social media, and other channels.
* Screen CVs and shortlist suitable candidates based on job requirements.
* Coordinate technical and management interviews with the concerned departments.

**2\. Employee Onboarding \& Documentation**


* Prepare and issue offer letters, appointment letters, confirmation letters, increment letters, and other HR documents.
* Collect and verify employee documents during the joining process.
* Maintain accurate and updated employee personal and employment records.
* Coordinate employee induction and joining formalities.

**3\. Attendance \& Leave Management**


* Monitor daily employee attendance and leave records.
* Maintain attendance through the company’s attendance management system.
* Follow up with employees regarding missing punches, late attendance, and leave requests.
* Prepare monthly attendance data for payroll processing.

**4\. Payroll \& Compliance Support**


* Coordinate monthly payroll inputs, salary revisions, deductions, incentives, and reimbursements.
* Support PF, ESI, professional tax, and other statutory compliance activities.
* Coordinate with the accounts/payroll team for salary processing.
* Maintain payroll\-related employee records and documentation.

**5\. Employee Relations \& HR Operations**


* Address employee queries related to HR policies, attendance, leave, salary, and company procedures.
* Support employee engagement and welfare activities.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee information.
* Ensure HR policies and procedures are communicated and followed.

**6\. Exit \& Full\-and\-Final Process**


* Manage resignation documentation and exit formalities.
* Coordinate notice period, handover, relieving, and experience letters.
* Provide required employee information for full\-and\-final settlement.
* Maintain proper records of employee exits.

**7\. HR Administration**


* Maintain employee files, HR trackers, and HR\-related databases.
* Prepare HR reports and MIS as required by management.
* Coordinate with different departments for employee\-related requirements.
* Support management in implementing HR policies and processes.

### **Required Skills \& Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 2–5 years of experience in HR operations and recruitment.
* Good knowledge of recruitment and employee lifecycle processes.
* Basic knowledge of payroll, PF, ESI, and statutory compliance.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong MS Excel and documentation skills.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle employee matters professionally.
* Good organizational and follow\-up skills.

### **Preferred Experience**


Experience in **engineering, MEP, HVAC, construction, or project\-based organizations** will be an added advantage.


### **Key Competencies**


* Recruitment \& Coordination
* HR Operations
* Employee Documentation
* Attendance \& Leave Management
* Payroll Coordination
* Statutory Compliance Support
* Employee Relations
* MS Excel \& HR MIS
* Communication \& Follow\-up
* Time Management

**About the Role**

We are looking for a **motivated fresher who wants to build a long\-term career in the EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) industry** and is interested in learning how B2B integration products work.

You will work closely with our product and technical teams and get **hands\-on exposure to EDI transactions, partner onboarding, file transfers, AS2, SFTP, APIs, and X12 documents**.

This is a learning\-oriented role where you will gradually develop the technical and functional knowledge required to work with our **EDI/B2B integration product**.

**What You'll Learn \& Work On**

* Understand the fundamentals of **EDI and B2B integrations**
* Learn common **X12 EDI transactions** such as 820, 835, 850, 855, 856, 810, 997, etc.
* Work with **AS2 and SFTP\-based file transfers**
* Understand EDI envelopes such as **ISA, GS and ST**
* Assist with **EDI partner onboarding and connectivity testing**
* Perform functional and integration testing of EDI workflows
* Monitor file transmission and transaction processing
* Investigate basic EDI/file transfer issues
* Work with APIs and understand how they integrate with EDI workflows
* Maintain test cases, documentation and issue tracking
* Collaborate with developers, QA and product teams
* Gradually take ownership of specific areas of the EDI product

**Who We're Looking For**

We are looking for someone who:

* Is a **fresher or has up to 1 year of experience**
* Has a genuine interest in learning **EDI and B2B integration**
* Is willing to learn new technologies and business processes
* Has good logical and analytical thinking
* Is comfortable working with technical teams
* Has good communication and documentation skills
* Is curious about how systems communicate and exchange data
* Is willing to learn through **hands\-on project work**
* Is looking for a **long\-term career in the EDI/B2B integration domain**

**Good to Have**

Knowledge of any of the following will be an advantage, but **is not mandatory**:

* API / REST API
* JSON / XML
* SQL
* Postman
* Basic networking concepts
* Software testing
* JavaScript or any programming language
* Git

**Why Join Us?**

This role is not just about getting your first job — it is an opportunity to **build expertise in a specialized technology domain**.

You will get the opportunity to:

✅ Learn EDI from the ground up  
✅ Work on a real\-world EDI/B2B integration product  
✅ Gain hands\-on experience with AS2, SFTP and X12  
✅ Work with real partner integration scenarios  
✅ Learn from developers, QA and product professionals  
✅ Develop both technical and functional EDI knowledge  
✅ Grow with the product and take on greater responsibilities over time

**Career Path**

**EDI Product Associate → EDI/Integration Engineer → Senior EDI/Integration Engineer → EDI Product Specialist / Product Engineer**

If you are a fresher who is **curious, willing to learn, and interested in building a career in EDI and B2B integration**, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Cybersecurity Penetration Testing Expert
description:
**Cybersecurity Penetration Testing Expert (AI Security)**
**About The Role**
 What if your hacking skills could directly shape how safe and secure AI systems are for millions of users worldwide? We're looking for Cybersecurity Penetration Testing Experts to probe, attack, and stress\-test AI\-powered applications and infrastructure — identifying vulnerabilities before bad actors do.
   

  

 This is a fully remote, flexible contract role where your offensive security expertise meets the cutting edge of artificial intelligence. You'll work on high\-impact projects that directly improve the security posture of AI systems used at scale.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Conduct penetration tests against AI\-powered applications, APIs, and infrastructure to uncover security vulnerabilities
* Identify and exploit weaknesses in AI/ML pipelines, including prompt injection, model manipulation, data poisoning vectors, and authentication flaws
* Perform web application, network, and API security assessments using industry\-standard tools and methodologies
* Simulate real\-world attack scenarios — from reconnaissance through exploitation and post\-exploitation
* Document findings in clear, structured reports with severity ratings, evidence, and actionable remediation guidance
* Evaluate AI\-specific attack surfaces including adversarial inputs, jailbreaks, and data exfiltration risks
* Stay current with emerging AI security threats and contribute insights to improve testing methodologies
* Work independently on task\-based engagements on your own schedule


**Who You Are**
* Experienced penetration tester with a strong understanding of offensive security principles and methodologies (OWASP, PTES, MITRE ATT\&CK)
* Proficient with industry\-standard tools such as Burp Suite, Metasploit, Nmap, Kali Linux, or equivalent
* Solid understanding of web application security, network security, and API security testing
* Able to think like an attacker — creative, persistent, and methodical in finding what others miss
* Strong written communication skills — you can translate complex technical findings into clear, actionable reports
* Self\-motivated and reliable when working independently without direct supervision
* Comfortable working across diverse technology stacks and environments


**Nice to Have**
* Relevant certifications such as OSCP, OSCE, CEH, GPEN, GXPN, or eWPT
* Experience with AI/ML security testing — adversarial machine learning, prompt injection, LLM red\-teaming
* Background in red teaming, bug bounty programs, or CTF competitions
* Familiarity with cloud security (AWS, GCP, Azure) and container security
* Programming or scripting skills in Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar
* Knowledge of secure development practices and DevSecOps workflows
* Experience conducting security assessments in compliance\-driven environments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, etc.)


**Why Join Us**
* Work on cutting\-edge AI security projects alongside leading research labs
* Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you
* Freelance autonomy with access to high\-impact, intellectually challenging engagements
* Be at the forefront of AI security — a rapidly growing field with massive demand
* Sharpen your skills against novel AI\-specific attack surfaces that few security professionals have encountered
* Contribute directly to making AI systems safer and more trustworthy for users worldwide
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

title: Assistant / Deputy Manager – OFR Export Operations
description:
**ABOUT OCEAN FREIGHT OPERATIONS**


The Ocean Freight Operations team plays a pivotal role in managing all ocean\-bound imports and exports, utilizing a diverse range of equipment and services. The team collaborates closely with a network of ocean carriers, Procurement \& capacity management (PCM), and participating in major carrier alliances to secure planned space protection from key container ports globally. This meticulous coordination is essential for ensuring a reliable and efficient transportation process for ocean\-bound cargo.

  

**JOB SUMMARY**

As an integral part of Ocean Freight Export Operations/ Documentation, an incumbent role in ensuring the efficiency of Export processes within the specified region. The role of OFR (Ocean Freight Operations) involves supporting the intricacies of ocean\-bound cargo movements. It involves coordinating with various processes, including vessel scheduling, cargo documentation, interaction with ocean carriers to constantly strive for optimizing efficiency, regulations, and maintaining high standards of service.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**


**Operational Excellence:**


* Ensure cost\-effective and high\-quality export ocean freight operations.
* Assist in procuring and managing cargo capacity efficiently, overseeing all port operations.
* Ensure operational compliance and error\-free documentation.
* Responsible for the smooth execution of export shipments, adhering to customer requirements, country regulations, and customs trade practices.
* Ensure regulatory compliance related to AMS, ACI, ISF, and FMC filing.
* Implement CW1 Best Practices, including auto rating, auto costing, timely and accurate cost estimation, billing, ESI \& E\-Booking, milestone updating, and file closure.
* Achieve set operational performance targets.
* Proactively address and manage operational irregularities.
* Efficiently handle customer complaints and plug potential revenue leakages.
* Avoid claims and penalties due to service failures.
* Adhere to agreed SOP/COP for releasing documents to customers (Cash/Credit).
* Manage the vendor payment process and shipment tracking.
* Coordinate with Gateway Operation Team for CFS stuffing containers \& consol.
* Collaborate with PCM team for carrier rates filing.
* Taking complete responsibility for independently managing customer accounts, guided by both supervisor and manager, following the 'one file, one operator' approach.
* Drive the implementation of sustainable environmental practices within the ocean freight operations, contributing to corporate social responsibility goals.

  

**Stakeholder Management**


* Enhance customer satisfaction by delivering exceptional services.
* Manage relationships with carriers, suppliers, and the network.
* Interface with the sales team and customer service team.

  

**Customer \& Network Support:**


* Enhance customer satisfaction through best\-in\-class services.
* Record complaints concerning all export shipments.
* Address and resolve network\-related issues.
* Maintain regular communication with sales and support teams.

  

**COMPETENCIES**


**Functional Competencies**


* Product Knowledge: Thorough knowledge of products, services, and logistics industry.
* Customer Service: Strong customer service skills to address inquiries, provide updates, and resolve issues related to shipments.
* Technology Proficiency: Implementing CW1 and other tools for optimizing operations.
* Customs Regulations Acumen: Understanding of customs procedures, tariff and international trade laws for industry regulations and standards.

**Behavioral Competencies**


* Agility: Ability to adapt quickly to changing operational needs and environments.
* Continuous Learning: Willingness to learn and improve skills to enhance performance.
* Attention to Detail: Consistently maintaining accuracy and precision in tasks and documentation.
* Quality Orientation: Commitment to delivering high\-quality results and services.
* Initiative: Taking proactive steps to improve processes or address issues without waiting for direction.
* Team Collaboration: Collaborating across teams for smooth operations.

**WHO CAN APPLY?**


**Must Have**


* 2\-3 years of experience in the shipping/logistics industry for Executive/Sr. Exec.
* 4\-5 years of experience in the shipping/logistics industry for AM/DM
* Bachelor’s degree in any field.
* Proven experience in running smooth operations processes.
* Basic problem\-solving skills to address common challenges.
* Proficient in Email writing and verbal communication with internal and external coordination.

  

**Preferred**


* Courses and certifications in business administration, operations management.
* Completed Cargo Basic and Dangerous Goods courses.

  

**Qualified freshers are welcome.**

**About the Role**

We are seeking a skilled and customer\-focused **IT Support Engineer** to provide end\-to\-end technical support for US\-based end users. In this role, you will diagnose and resolve hardware, software, network, and system issues, ensuring high user satisfaction and operational continuity.

If you possess strong technical troubleshooting abilities, fluent English communication, and a passion for resolving complex IT tickets, we invite you to apply.

* **Education:** Diploma or Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Applications, or a related technical discipline.
* **Communication Skills:** Excellent spoken and written English skills; strong interpersonal etiquette to interact confidently and professionally with US clients.
* **Technical Proficiency:**
* Solid understanding of Windows OS, network connectivity, and basic hardware setup.
* Hands\-on familiarity with MS Office 365, Outlook configurations, and remote access tools (e.g., AnyDesk, TeamViewer, RDP).
* **Flexibility:** Willingness to work in night shifts or rotational shifts to align with US business hours.

title: Admin & Puja Operations Executive
description:
**About Devaseva:**

Devaseva is a faithtech platform that enables devotees to participate in traditional Hindu pujas, homas, sevas, and other Vedic rituals online.

We are looking for an **Admin \& Puja Operations Executive** to launch seva campaigns, manage devotee data, sankalpa coordination, prasad shipment data, and post\-seva communications.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Launch seva campaigns through the Devaseva admin portal.
* Add and update seva details, options, dates, pricing, images, and other campaign information.
* Take the required content and images from the Content and Design teams and upload them accurately.
* Check campaigns before and after they go live for any errors.
* Download devotee booking data from the admin portal in the required format.
* Update Devotees family member and gothra details when devotees request additions or corrections after booking.
* Share accurate and verified Devotees data for Seva Sankalpa with the Puja Operations team on time.
* Prepare devotee and address data in the required format for **Shiprocket** and share it with the Operations team for prasad shipments.
* Monitor live YouTube sevas to ensure all booked devotee names are read by the Purohit and coordinate with the Purohit/Puja Operations team to re\-read any missed names during the live seva.
* Coordinate with freelancers/team members to prepare **Youtube sankalpa timestamps** and ensure they are accurately mapped to the respective devotee/family names.
* Coordinate with the **Customer Support team** to send **Youtube seva link and individual sankalpa timestamps** with devotees.
* Maintain trackers for bookings, sankalpa updates, timestamps, shipments, and other operational activities.
* Coordinate with Content, Design, Puja Operations, Customer Support, Purohits, freelancers, and other teams to ensure smooth execution of sevas.

**Required Skills:**

* Good knowledge of **Excel / Google Sheets**.
* Good data\-entry and data\-management skills.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to work with multiple teams.
* Comfortable working with admin portals and online tools.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
* Good written English.
* Basic knowledge of YouTube and online platforms is an advantage.

**Preferred Experience:**

* 1–3 years of experience in administration, operations, data management, e\-commerce operations, or a similar role.
* Freshers with good computer skills and strong attention to detail may also be considered.

**Working Days \& Work Arrangement:**

* **5 days working from the office, Saturday – Work From Home (WFH)**.
* Sevas are conducted on **Sundays and festive days** as well, so the employee may be required to work on Sundays or public holidays depending on the seva schedule.
* **Weekly offs and compensatory offs will be provided accordingly** based on the seva and operational schedule.
* Flexibility to work on Sundays/festive days is an important requirement for this role.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

About the Company
 



 ZeTheta Algorithms Private Limited is a FinTech start\-up which has been recently set up and is developing innovative AI tools. https://www.instagram.com/zetheta.official
 



  





 About the Role
 



 The Full Stack Engineer Intern will be responsible for developing the online platforms which shall include frontend, backend, APIs, and data processing logic. This includes wireframing, building the website's home page, password authentication, dashboards post login, and AI features integration. Extensive model building with algorithms is involved.
 



  





 Responsibilities
 



 Develop responsive web interfaces using HTML, CSS, and PHP. Develop interactive UI using React.js with Tailwind CSS or alternatives such as Vue.js and Angular. Design UI for multiple AI features. Utilize UI libraries like Bootstrap or Material UI for styling. Design, build, and implement secure RESTful APIs using Node.js with Express.js. Implement authentication systems using Firebase free tier or PostgreSQL with Supabase. Store and retrieve intern, employer, and job data on MongoDB Atlas (free tier). Connect APIs with the frontend and collaborate with team members to integrate frontend components with server\-side logic. Develop a blockchain\-based certificate verification system. Develop and maintain server\-side applications using frameworks such as Django, Flask, Express (Node.js), Rails (Ruby), Spring (Java), or Laravel (PHP). Troubleshoot and optimize backend performance.
 



  





 Qualifications
 



 Basic proficiency in one or more backend frameworks. Strong programming skills in HTML, CSS, React.js, Tailwind CSS, PHP, Python, JavaScript, and Ruby. Understanding of API integration using Axios or Fetch. Familiarity with MongoDB, PostgreSQL, SQLite, and NoSQL databases. Ability to work independently in a remote setting.
 



  





 Benefits
 



 Opportunity to build practical skills with modern backend technologies. Enhance your professional portfolio. Exposure to real\-world development projects in a remote work environment.
 



  





 Internship Details
 



 Duration: Self\-paced. Options of 15 days, 1 month, 2 months, 3 months, 4 months, or 6 months. Type: Unpaid.
 



  





 Application Process
 



 Join us through online enrolment — simply submit your updated CV. We do not conduct any interview or assessment. All motivated early career talent are welcome to take up the role.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Setlmint is a technology platform that simplifies and automate business transactions and financial operations. The platform helps organizations digitally approve and pay supplier bills, employee claims, and petty cash, while enabling faster customer collections and eliminating manual reconciliation. Setlmint also supports cashflow forecasting and management through a unified dashboard that tracks key business trends. Its products integrate with leading accounting systems such as SAP and Tally, as well as major banks
 



  





**Role Description** 




  





 This is a full\-time, on\-site Software Engineer role based in Mumbai. ONLY MUMBAI CANDIDATES MAY APPLY
 



  





 The Software Engineer will design, develop, test, and maintain backend services and APIs that power Setlmint’s financial operations platform.
 



  





**Responsibilities include** 



* Implementing scalable and secure server\-side logic, integrating with third\-party accounting and banking systems, and optimizing application performance.
* Collaborating with product managers, data specialists, and other engineers to translate business requirements into technical solutions, as well as writing clean, maintainable code and participating in code reviews.
* Improve development processes, contribute to system architecture decisions, and troubleshoot production issues to ensure reliable platform performance.



**Qualifications** 



* Strong foundation in Computer Science concepts, including data structures, algorithms, and software engineering principles.
* Proficiency in Software Development and Back\-End Web Development, with experience building and maintaining server\-side applications and APIs.
* Solid Programming skills and hands\-on experience with Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP) in one or more modern languages (e.g., Java, C\#, Python, or similar).
* Experience with databases (SQL/NoSQL), RESTful services, and integration with third\-party systems such as accounting platforms or banking APIs.
* Familiarity with version control (e.g., Git), testing frameworks, and CI/CD practices.
* Ability to work collaboratively in an on\-site team environment, communicate clearly, and take ownership of deliverables.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
