title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**Associate Product Manager (APM)** 




**SBNRI · Product · \[Gurgaon, in\-office] · \[0–2 years] · \[Full\-time]** 




  





**About SBNRI** 





 35 million NRIs are trying to manage their money from thousands of miles away, and most of them don't trust anyone enough to help. SBNRI is building the company that changes that. We help NRIs in 120\+ countries invest and manage money in India: mutual funds, fixed deposits, taxation, compliance, and repatriation.
 




**The role** 





 You'll own real product problems end to end: figure out what's broken, work out why, ship the fix with Engineering and Design, and measure whether it worked. You'll report to the Head of Product and work closely with Engineering, Design, Growth, Operations, and leadership.
 





 Problems like the ones you'll work on:
 



* Why does an NRI in Dubai start onboarding and not finish?
* What makes an investor redeem, and what could have kept them?
* Which manual workflows should AI be running instead of people?



  





**What you'll do** 



* **Define winning before you build:** 

 Every initiative starts with a success metric. If you can't say what "this worked" looks like in numbers, it isn't ready.
* **Execution:** 

 Write clear requirements, drive delivery with Engineering and Design, clear blockers, and close the loop. A task is yours until the outcome is delivered, not until you hand it off.
* **Analytics:** 

 Track funnels, adoption, and conversion. Judge features by whether they move the business, not by whether they shipped.
* **Talk to users every week:** 

 Have direct conversations with NRIs across geographies. Dashboards and CS summaries don't replace them. Support tickets and payment failures are requirements we missed, and you'll help trace them to root cause.
* **AI and automation:** 

 Use AI tools daily to research, prototype, and automate. If something is repetitive, your first question should be "why isn't this automated?"
* **Experimentation:** 

 Frame hypotheses, define success metrics, and read results honestly, including when an experiment fails.



  





**What we look for** 





 You don't need PM experience. We look for evidence of how you think and build:
 



* **A product project:** 

 a college project, app, website, or prototype you took from idea to something usable
* **Analytical thinking:** 

 the ability to take apart a product, find a real user problem, and back your fix with reasoning or data
* **AI fluency:** 

 practical use of AI tools to research, prototype, or automate something real
* **Ownership:** 

 a clear example of something you drove to completion, especially when it got hard



  





**How we work** 





 Your work will be challenged, and not in quarterly reviews. It happens in the moment, by the person next to you. A design gets torn apart because an NRI in Dubai would find it confusing. A feature gets sent back because it solves our problem, not the user's. That isn't conflict; it's how craft works when people care.
 





 We don't optimize for comfort. We optimize for the NRI in San Jose at 11pm, trying to figure out if their money in India is safe. That person deserves our best thinking, our fastest execution, and our most obsessive attention to detail.
 





 If that standard feels like pressure, this isn't the right place. If it feels like the point, you'll do the best work of your life here.
 




  





**Why SBNRI** 



* A small team, so your work ships and is visible to leadership from week one
* A rare domain: cross\-border, regulated wealth for a global customer base
* A steep learning curve across product, data, compliance, and growth



  





**How to apply** 





 Email
 
**sanskriti@sbnri.com** 

 with the subject "
 
**Application for Associate Product Manager – SBNRI** 

 ." Include:
 



1. Your resume
2. **One link** 

 to something you've built or analysed. This could be a product teardown, prototype, project, or a short doc on a problem you'd fix in any app you use.



**Applications without the link won't be reviewed.**

title: Associate Product Manager, Growth
description:
We're hiring an Associate Product Manager, Growth for a San Francisco based company.
 



  





 We're a small team of experienced operators building a platform that turns a plain\-English description into a live, hosted app with billing built in — no code to own or maintain. hundreds of new builders sign up every week and most publish an app in their first week. Our paid tier is launching now.
 



  





 We're looking for an early\-career product person who wants to learn growth by doing it: running experiments, digging into data and shipping changes that turn free builders into paying customers. You'll work directly with the founders, who will mentor you closely.
 



  





 WHAT YOU'LL DO
 



 • Funnel analysis. Track how builders move from signup to first app to paid, find where they drop off, and bring the founders clear, data\-backed ideas to fix it.
 



  





 • Experiments. Help design and run tests on onboarding, templates, upgrade prompts, pricing pages and plans. Make sure each one is measured properly and write up what we learned.
 



  





 • Specs and shipping. Write short, clear specs and work with our engineers every week to get changes live.
 



  





 • User research. Talk to builders — the ones who pay, the ones who leave — and turn what you hear into product ideas.
 



  





 • Dashboards. Build and maintain our funnel, cohort retention and conversion dashboards.
 



  





 • Acquisition support. Work with our paid\-ads specialist on landing pages and signup flows so new traffic converts.
 



  





 WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR
 



 • 1–2 years of experience at a SaaS or software company — in product, growth, marketing analytics, customer success or operations — and a clear interest in moving into product
 



 • Strong with data: comfortable with spreadsheets and basic SQL, or quick to learn an analytics tool like Mixpanel, Amplitude or GA4
 



 • Curious about why users behave the way they do, and happy to spend time talking to them
 



 • Clear writer and communicator in English
 



 • You'd rather ship a small test this week than write a big plan
 



 • Able to overlap a few hours a day with US Pacific time
 



 • Nice to have: a product or growth internship at a SaaS startup; you've built and launched something yourself; experience with AI or no\-code tools
 



  





 WHAT WE OFFER
 



 • Competitive salary

**About AppsForBharat (Sri Mandir)** 




 AppsForBharat is a Series C funded faith\-tech startup backed by leading investors including Fundamentum, Susquehanna Asia VC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital), Elevation Capital, and BEENEXT. Our team draws talent from IITs, IIMs and other premier institutes, with deep experience scaling high\-growth consumer internet startups.
 



 Our flagship product, Sri Mandir, launched in November 2020, is the world's largest app for Hindu devotees — a digital sanctuary offering seamless access to sacred rituals, divine teachings, and a vibrant spiritual community. The app is growing 20–25% month\-on\-month, and we are now building
 **Sri Mandir Web** 
 to extend this experience to millions of devotees who discover and engage with us through the browser.
 



 The devotion market in India is a $44B opportunity growing at 10% CAGR, of which temples alone drive \~$27B in GMV. Web is a critical, largely untapped channel to capture this opportunity at scale through organic discovery, SEO, and frictionless devotee journeys.
 



  





**Product Role Overview** 




 As Product Manager for
 **Sri Mandir Web** 
 , you will own the end\-to\-end product lifecycle for building a fast, engaging, and trustworthy website that serves millions of devotees worldwide. This is a first\-principles, high\-ownership role, you will be expected to question existing assumptions, reimagine devotee journeys for the web (a fundamentally different medium from app), and build measurable, compounding growth loops around acquisition, engagement, and monetisation.
 



 You will be especially responsible for how devotees are acquired, including through SEO. Reimagine how devotees experience the site pre\- and post\-transaction in their journey, and turn a one\-time visitor into a returning, engaged devotee.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





***Product Vision \& Strategy***




 • Define and own the Sri Mandir Web Product roadmap, grounded in first\-principles thinking that works for Web audience.
 



 • Identify the highest\-leverage problems in the devotee journey by breaking them down to root causes, not surface symptoms.
 



 • Work with Website P\&L lead, to own the complete business flywheel and deliver retention and revenue outcomes
 



  





***Acquisition \& Organic Growth***




 • Own complete acquisition funnels with a strong focus on organic and SEO\-driven growth alongside paid and referral channels.
 



 • Partner closely with Analytics, CRM, Content, Marketing, Design and Engineering teams to define the site architecture that drives speed and enable discoverability at scale.

 • Apply deep, empathetic, user\-first thinking to design web journeys that feel intuitive, trustworthy, and delightful for devotees
 



 • Design and continuously refine post\-transaction user flows, cross\-sell and re\-engagement journeys, that build habitual, repeat engagement
 



  





***Data\-Driven Decision Making***




 • Leverage analytics, cohort analysis, user research, and market insights to identify problems, size opportunities, and prioritise the roadmap.
 



 • Set up and track KPIs across the funnel, traffic, conversion, ARPU, retention, and repeat transactions
 



  





***Ownership \& Cross\-Functional Leadership***




 • Lead the product lifecycle from concept and requirements to launch and post\-launch optimisation.
 



 • Stay ahead of web/SEO trends, competitor moves, and emerging technologies to keep Sri Mandir Web at the frontier of devotional tech.
 



  





**What You Bring** 




 • Bachelors or Masters degree from Tier 1 premier institute — IIT, BITS Pilani, IIM, ISB preferred.

 • First\-principles thinker: Demonstrated ability to solve ambiguous, complex problems from the ground up rather than relying on existing playbooks.
 



 • Web acquisition \& SEO: Product knowledge of SEO and organic acquisition levers (technical SEO, content strategy, site performance)
 



 Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex, funnel\-level datasets.
 



 • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
 



  





**Bonus Points** 




 • Past founding or entrepreneurial experience.
 



 • Hands\-on experience with SEO/organic growth as a primary growth lever in a previous role.
 



 • Experience managing products across Web platforms.
 



 • Past experience building and growing e\-commerce products.
 



  





**Why You'll Love It Here** 




 • Build India's next\-generation devotional web experience from the ground up, for millions of devotees worldwide.
 



 • True end\-to\-end ownership: idea, build, launch, scale.
 



 • Highly collaborative, autonomous work culture.
 



 • Competitive compensation and performance\-based incentives.
 



 • Health \& wellness benefits for you and your family.
 



 • A serene, pet\-friendly, peaceful office in the heart of HSR Layout, Bangalore.

At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high\-quality medicines worldwide.
   

  

 At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide.  The Digital \& Innovation group at USP is seeking a Product Manager who can drive and deliver digital tech solutions. We are seeking someone who excels in digital innovation for building impactful data products across our ecosystem.

 As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high\-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. * Core analytics capabilities include the ability to instrument critical metrics, identify the landscape of the entire function, determine opportunities for improvement, work with Product to craft scalable solutions, and monitor their performance.

title: Associate Delivery Manager
description:
**Overview of 66degrees** 




 66degrees is an end\-to\-end AI transformation partner that guides enterprises from complex business challenges to clear, quantifiable outcomes. Our company is the culmination of several successful firms, each a leader in its own right in cloud, artificial intelligence, and data. This convergence of talent and expertise is how we help businesses reach their own "inflection point," where chaotic data becomes a strategic asset, complexity becomes clarity, and AI becomes an engine for growth. Our ultimate vision is to be the catalyst for a future where every business operates as an intelligent enterprise, with autonomous systems unlocking human potential.
 



 At 66degrees, we believe in thriving through challenges and winning together. These values not only guide us in achieving our goals as a company but also for our people. We are dedicated to creating a significant impact for our employees by fostering a culture that sparks innovation and supports professional and personal growth along the way.
 



**Overview Of Role** 




 We are seeking a highly motivated and collaborative Associate Delivery Manager with a strong Agile and Scrum background to support the successful delivery of customer\-facing technology programs across cloud, data, AI, analytics, and application development initiatives.
 



 This role is ideal for professionals with approximately 3\+ years of experience who have worked as a Scrum Master, Project Coordinator, Agile Delivery Lead, Technical Project Coordinator, or Associate Project Manager and are looking to grow into broader Delivery Management responsibilities.
 



 The ideal candidate will play a key role in facilitating Agile delivery, coordinating cross\-functional teams, removing delivery impediments, and ensuring timely execution of project milestones. You will partner closely with Delivery Managers, Product Owners, Architects, Engineering teams, and customers to deliver high\-quality technology solutions while continuously improving Agile maturity and delivery excellence. In addition to supporting larger and more complex programs, you will also have the opportunity to independently manage smaller customer engagements as the Delivery Manager, taking ownership of planning, execution, stakeholder communication, and successful delivery.
 



**Responsibilities** 




**Delivery Coordination** 



* Support the successful delivery of software, cloud, data, AI, and application development projects.
* Coordinate sprint execution, release planning, project tracking, and delivery milestones.
* Assist Delivery Managers in monitoring project health, risks, dependencies, and delivery schedules.
* Track project progress, team capacity, resource allocation, and delivery metrics.
* Escalate delivery risks and blockers proactively while driving timely resolution.
* Ensure project documentation, governance artifacts, and status reports are maintained accurately.
* Support multiple concurrent Agile projects and distributed engineering teams.
* Independently manage smaller customer engagements as the Delivery Manager, owning end\-to\-end delivery including planning, execution, stakeholder communication, risk management, and successful project outcomes.
* Balance responsibilities across independently managed engagements while providing delivery support to larger, strategic programs led by senior Delivery Managers.



**Agile Delivery \& Scrum Leadership** 



* Facilitate Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Sprint Reviews, Backlog Refinement, and Sprint Retrospectives.
* Coach Scrum teams on Agile principles, Scrum values, and continuous improvement practices.
* Partner with Product Owners to maintain healthy product backlogs and sprint priorities.
* Track sprint progress, velocity, burndown charts, and release readiness.
* Identify delivery bottlenecks and work with teams to remove impediments.
* Foster accountability, collaboration, transparency, and ownership across Agile teams.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives based on retrospective outcomes and delivery metrics.



**Project Governance \& Reporting** 



* Prepare project status reports, dashboards, and delivery metrics for stakeholders.
* Monitor sprint health, schedule adherence, defect leakage, resource utilization, and delivery milestones.
* Maintain project plans, RAID logs (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies), and action trackers.
* Ensure compliance with delivery governance standards and organizational processes.
* Support forecasting activities, release planning, and sprint commitments.



**Stakeholder Management** 



* Build collaborative relationships with internal stakeholders and customer teams.
* Communicate project status, delivery progress, risks, and mitigation plans effectively.
* Coordinate cross\-functional activities to ensure alignment between business and engineering teams.
* Support customer meetings, sprint demos, governance reviews, and project updates.
* Serve as the primary Delivery Manager and customer point of contact for smaller engagements, ensuring effective stakeholder communication, governance, and customer satisfaction.
* Maintain a customer\-first mindset throughout project execution.



**Continuous Improvement** 



* Promote Agile best practices across delivery teams.
* Encourage knowledge sharing, collaboration, and process improvements.
* Identify opportunities to improve delivery efficiency, predictability, and team productivity.
* Contribute to organizational Agile maturity initiatives.
* Support Delivery Managers in implementing operational excellence initiatives.



**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 3\+ years of experience as a Scrum Master, Agile Project Coordinator, Associate Project Manager, Delivery Coordinator, or similar role, with demonstrated ability or readiness to independently manage smaller customer engagements.
* Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, Scrum framework, Kanban, and modern software delivery practices.
* Experience facilitating Agile ceremonies and managing sprint execution.
* Hands\-on experience working with cross\-functional software engineering teams.
* Good understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
* Experience using Agile project management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
* Understanding of Agile metrics including Sprint Velocity, Burndown Charts, Cycle Time, Lead Time, Defect Leakage, Resource Utilization, Schedule Adherence, and Delivery Milestones.
* Experience coordinating multiple workstreams within Agile projects.
* Strong communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, and organizational skills.
* Excellent problem\-solving and conflict\-resolution abilities.
* Ability to work effectively in fast\-paced, collaborative environments.
* Exposure to cloud technologies (Google Cloud Platform, AWS, or Azure) is preferred.
* Exposure to AI, Data, Analytics, or Application Development projects is an added advantage.



**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), SAFe Scrum Master, or equivalent Agile certification.
* Experience working in consulting, professional services, or customer\-facing organizations.
* Exposure to cloud migration, AI/ML, data modernization, analytics, or digital transformation projects.
* Experience supporting distributed or global engineering teams.
* Familiarity with delivery governance, release management, and Agile reporting.
* Experience independently managing small to mid\-sized customer engagements or end\-to\-end project delivery is preferred.
* Passion for coaching Agile teams and driving continuous improvement.



*66degrees is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, national origin, age, weight, height, marital status, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability status or other legally protected class.*

title: Software Engineer - Entry Level
description:
**About Bornwest** 




  





 Bornwest builds products that bring delight, efficiency, and connection to organizations worldwide. We are a remote\-first, high\-ownership team that moves fast, values craftsmanship, and treats every engineer as a first\-class citizen of the product. We are growing our India team and looking for passionate fresh graduates who are eager to learn, build, and grow with us.
 



  





**The Role** 




  





 We are hiring Software Developers with 0–2 years of experience to join our India engineering team. This is a full\-stack role — you will work on both backend (Ruby on Rails) and frontend (JavaScript / React), building real features for real customers from Day 1\.
 



  





 We are looking for people who are passionate, curious, and self\-motivated. You don't need to know everything — you need to love learning, take ownership, and never stop asking questions.
 



  





**Tech Stack** 




  





**Backend** 




 Ruby on Rails
 



 REST APIs, PostgreSQL
 



 Background jobs (Sidekiq)
 



  





**Frontend** 




 JavaScript / React
 



 HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind
 



 Responsive UI development
 



 Tooling \& Practices
 



 Git \& GitHub
 



 Agile / sprint\-based workflow
 



  





**What You Will Do** 




  





 • Build and ship features across our product using Ruby on Rails and JavaScript/React
 



 • Write clean, readable, and well\-tested code
 



 • Participate in code reviews — both giving and receiving feedback
 



 • Work closely with the product and design team to understand requirements and translate them into working software
 



 • Debug and fix issues — own problems end\-to\-end
 



 • Contribute to technical discussions and architecture decisions as you grow
 



 • Learn fast — our codebase will teach you things no textbook can
 



  





**Who We Are Looking For** 




  





 • Fresh graduate or 0–2 years of professional experience in software development
 



 • B.Tech / BCA / B.Sc (Computer Science, IT, ECE, or related field)
 



 • Strong understanding of programming fundamentals — data structures, algorithms, complexity
 



 • Familiarity with at least one backend or frontend language (Ruby, Python, JavaScript, Java, etc.)
 



 • Understanding of how the web works — HTTP, APIs, databases
 



 • Basic knowledge of SQL and relational databases
 



 • Comfort with Git for version control
 



 • Strong problem\-solving mindset — willingness to figure things out independently
 



  





**Nice to Have** 




  





 • Prior experience with Ruby on Rails (even via personal projects or tutorials)
 



 • Exposure to React or any modern JavaScript framework
 



 • Any deployed project — open source contribution, hackathon project, internship work
 



 • Familiarity with agile / sprint\-based workflows
 



 • Strong academic record — but we value curiosity and hustle over grades
 



  





**Compensation \& Perks** 




  





 We offer competitive fresher compensation benchmarked to the India market. Details are discussed during the offer stage.
 



  





**Work \& Lifestyle** 




  





 Remote\-first — work from anywhere in India
 



 Monthly in\-person meetup (team / office)
 



 Flexible hours — outcome\-based culture
 



 Annual full\-company offsite
 



  





**Benefits \& Equipment** 




  





 Laptop \+ accessories provided from Day 1
 



 Food coupons
 



 Structured onboarding \& training program
 



  





**Important** 




  





**Direct outreach to employees for referrals, bypassing our official application process, will result in immediate disqualification.** 




  





 Bornwest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, geographies, and experiences.

title: Associate Front-end Engineer — AI Product
description:
**About Goonj** 




  






 We are an early\-stage, stealth\-mode AI product company building a voice\-first conversational platform for young professionals from diverse backgrounds. The stack is current (React/React Native, TypeScript, Python backends, AWS, voice AI), the team is small, and the work moves fast.
 




  





**Role Overview** 




  





**We are hiring an Associate Frontend Engineer \- AI Product** 





 This is a build\-and\-own role. In the early days you'll be integrating vendor\-delivered designs and components and making targeted UI changes. As you ramp, you'll take on broader front\-end ownership — our mobile app, our website, and the AI\-assisted creative work (including ad creation) that supports the product. We want someone who starts by faithfully wiring up what others design and ends up as the custodian of the entire UI surface.
 





 The role is based out of Lucknow.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* UI Integration \& Vendor Collaboration
* Take React Native work delivered by our UI/UX vendors and own its integration into the live mobile app — wire components to backend APIs (REST and WebSocket), connect designs to real data, and make the handoff seamless.
* Serve as the technical bridge between our UI/UX vendors and our internal team — review what they deliver, give clear feedback, and make sure their output reaches users intact.
* Translate Figma/design specs into working, responsive, production\-quality screens.
* Catch and resolve the gaps where a vendor design meets backend reality — state, auth, error handling, edge cases.



  




* Front\-End Development \& Ownership
* Make day\-to\-day changes and improvements to the UI across the mobile app and website — bug fixes, polish, new screens, performance work.
* Build and maintain reusable component patterns so the UI stays consistent as it grows.
* Own front\-end performance: profiling, bundle size, lazy loading, smooth interactions.
* Over time, become the
 
**custodian of the UI** 

 — the person accountable for the front\-end's quality, consistency, and roadmap.



  




* Website \& AI\-Assisted Creative
* Own front\-end changes to our marketing website and other web surfaces.
* Use AI tools to help produce creative assets — including ad creation — and build lightweight workflows that make that fast and repeatable.
* Pick up adjacent technical work across our web presence as the need arises.



  




* Communication \& Collaboration
* Work directly with the founder; translate technical trade\-offs into plain language for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Flag risks and blockers early — especially where vendor deliveries don't match what we need.
* Stay current with the front\-end and GenAI tooling landscape and bring opportunities to the table.



  





**Required Skills \& Experience** 




  




* 1\+ year of professional experience building front\-end software.
* Strong in
 
**React** 

 — components, hooks, state management (Redux or equivalent), routing, and async data flows. You can take a design and ship a clean, responsive implementation.
* Comfortable in
 
**JavaScript/TypeScript** 

 , modern CSS (Tailwind, Sass, or similar), and responsive design.
* Hands\-on
 
**REST API integration** 

 — wiring a UI to real backend services, handling loading/error/empty states properly.
* Solid debugging and profiling instincts (browser/React DevTools), and a habit of writing readable, maintainable code.
* Comfortable with
 
**Git/GitHub** 

 and working in an Agile, vendor\-collaborative environment.
* Honest, direct communication — especially when something is broken, unclear, or a vendor delivery falls short.



  





**Preferred (Not Required)** 




  




* **React Native / mobile app** 

 experience. If you've shipped web React but not React Native, that's fine — we expect you to ramp into it quickly, and the role is designed to grow you into it.
* Experience collaborating with external
 
**UI/UX vendors** 

 or working from Figma handoffs.
* Exposure to
 
**AI tools and LLM APIs** 

 (Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter) — prompt\-driven workflows, API integration, or AI\-assisted content/creative generation.
* A
 
**UX/design sensibility** 

 — usability instincts, research methods, or an eye for detail that makes you a credible custodian of the product's look and feel.
* WebSocket / real\-time UI experience, and exposure to voice or conversational interfaces.
* Basic AWS familiarity and an understanding of how front\-end fits into a deployed system.
* A side project or product you actually shipped — tutorials don't count.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 




  




* **First 30 days** 

 : You can run the full app locally, you've integrated your first vendor\-delivered screen end\-to\-end, and you've shipped a real UI change to the mobile app.
* **First 90 days** 

 : Vendor handoffs flow through you cleanly, the UI is more consistent and faster than when you arrived, and you've owned at least one website or creative\-tooling improvement start to finish.
* **First 6 months** 

 : You're the custodian of our front\-end — the person who decides how the UI is built and who keeps it coherent as the product and the team grow.



  





**How We Work** 




  




* Small team, in\-person in Lucknow, direct collaboration with the founder.
* Stealth product — you'll see the full product and roadmap from day one, but everything stays internal.
* AI\-literate culture: use the tools (Claude, Cursor, Gemini, etc.) openly and well. We care that you understand what you ship, not whether you typed every character.
* We assume good faith, talk straight, and deliver.

title: Associate Technical Publication Engineer
description:
**About Welocalize** 
  
 


  


 Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI\-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
 


  


  
 


  


 Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. 
 *welocalize.com* 
  
 



  





  


**Summary:** 



  


 We are looking for a 
 **Technical Publication Engineer** 
 to manage, validate, develop, and publish technical documentation for global software products.
 


  


 The role covers the end\-to\-end publication lifecycle, including source\-file management, localization readiness, documentation development, technical QA, defect resolution, and publishing. The ideal candidate should have experience with structured documentation, XML/Markdown, version control, localization workflows, and documentation QA.
 


  


 The role involves close collaboration with technical writers, localization teams, project managers, and client stakeholders to deliver accurate, consistent, and publication\-ready content.
 


  






  




**Key Responsibilities** 
  

 Technical Documentation \& Source Management
   

  
* Retrieve, validate, and manage the correct and latest source files, assets, and documentation versions
  
* Analyse source content to determine translation/localization scope and prepare files for localization
  
* Develop and maintain technical documentation using XML, Markdown, HTML, JSON, and other formats
  
* Validate document structure, metadata, links, references, and content integrity
  
* Manage version\-controlled and single\-source documentation and generate multiple publication outputs
  

  


  

 Localization \& Quality Assurance
   

  
* Validate source and translated files for structure, content, formatting, functionality, and localization readiness
  
* Perform technical, functional, and visual QA of documentation and published outputs
  
* Identify and resolve issues related to content, formatting, links, XML/Markdown, metadata, images, fonts, encoding, and rendering
  
* Compare source and localized content and track defects through appropriate systems
  
* Coordinate defect resolution and ensure issues are addressed before final publication
  

  


  

 Publishing
   

  
* Configure and execute documentation publishing workflows
  
* Generate outputs such as online help, PDF, Word, CHM, HTML, and ZIP packages
  
* Troubleshoot build, transformation, publishing, and rendering issues
  
* Rebuild and republish documentation following corrections
  
* Ensure final outputs meet project and customer requirements
  

  


  

 Collaboration \& Process Improvement
   

  
* Work closely with documentation, localization, project management, and client teams
  
* Provide timely project updates and proactively communicate risks, issues, and dependencies
  
* Manage multiple requests while meeting quality and delivery timelines
  
* Identify process improvements that increase efficiency, quality, and reduce production risks
  
* Maintain work instructions, SOPs, and project documentation
  
* Demonstrate ownership, accountability, analytical thinking, and attention to detail
  

  


  


  




**Technical Skills \& Tools** 

**Documentation \& Authoring:** 
 XML Editors, Markdown, Microsoft Word, Excel, Adobe FrameMaker, AEM
 


  


**Publishing \& Graphics:** 
 Adobe Acrobat Pro, Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign
 


  


**Version Control \& Content Management:** 
 Git/GitHub, AEM, documentation repositories
 


  


**Localization \& Defect Management:** 
 Phrase/Memsource, Jira
 


  


**Text \& File Comparison:** 
 Beyond Compare, EmEditor, EditPlus, Sublime Text
 


  


**Multimedia:** 
 Snagit, Camtasia, Aegisub
 



  




**Required Skills** 
  

  
* Strong understanding of technical documentation and publishing processes
  
* Experience with XML, Markdown, or other structured documentation formats
  
* Understanding of localization, translation, and content management workflows
  
* Ability to troubleshoot structured content, publishing, and rendering issues
  
* Experience with document QA, defect tracking, and issue resolution
  
* Understanding of version control, file structures, metadata, encoding, fonts, and publication formats
  
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, organizational, and communication skills
  
* Ability to work with multiple tools and applications in a fast\-paced environment
  
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality
  
* Willingness to learn new tools, technologies, and processes
  

  


  


  




**Qualification and Experience** 
  

  
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline
  
* **1–2 years of experience** 
 in Technical Publications, Technical Writing, Documentation Engineering, Documentation QA, Localization Engineering, or a related field
  
* Experience with XML, Markdown, or structured documentation formats
  
* Familiarity with publishing, content management, localization, version control, and defect tracking tools
  
* Familiarity with Adobe and Microsoft Office applications
  
* Experience in a multi\-author or enterprise documentation environment is an advantage
  

  


  


  




**Other Relevant Skills** 
  
* Excellent verbal and written literacy skills
  
* Good ability to analyze and solve problems
  
* Strong desire for new skills and knowledge
  
* Strong sense of responsibility
  
* Flexibility and strong cooperation spirit
  
* Carefulness and patience
  
* Demonstrates an understanding of all aspects of the documentation localization process
  
* Demonstrates excellent troubleshooting skills and ability to logically think through problems

Building on a heritage of over 100 years as a trusted industry partner, the company serves customers in more than 100 locations in over 50 countries. You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting\-edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions. At Accelleron, we foster diversity and inclusion, welcoming and celebrating individual differences as a source of strength.**
 As an Emissions Executive you will be responsible for ensuring that daily voyage data collected through voyage reporting activities is accurate, complete, and quality assured to support delegated clients with emissions compliance and reporting services. You will manage client queries, perform voyage\-level emissions assessments, and support the allocation and verification of emissions data across various chartering activities.
   

  

 Working within the
 **Emissions Services** 
 team, you will contribute to the delivery of high\-quality emissions reporting and compliance support services for maritime clients.
   

  

 Reporting to the
 **Emissions Specialist** 
 , you will perform daily operational tasks, support timely reporting requirements, and help ensure compliance with applicable environmental regulations and customer commitments.

Role Overview

BM Elite International Clinic is looking for an **Admin \& HR Executive** to manage the day\-to\-day administrative and human\-resource functions of the clinic.

Vendor \& Facility Coordination

* Follow up on maintenance, electrical, plumbing, air\-conditioning, IT and other facility\-related issues.
* Monitor housekeeping standards and cleanliness of the clinic.
* Coordinate biomedical/general waste\-related administrative requirements with the responsible team.

Documentation \& Reporting

* Maintain organised HR and administrative records.
* Prepare daily/weekly/monthly reports requested by management.
* Maintain staff attendance and leave summaries.
* Maintain recruitment and vacancy status reports.
* Maintain updated employee contact and emergency information.

Coordination With Front Office \& Clinical Teams

* Good interpersonal and communication skills.

* Ability to work independently and take responsibility for assigned tasks.
* Proficiency in MS Word, Excel, email and basic office software.

Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be:

* Organised and systematic.
* Professional in communication and appearance.
* Comfortable interacting with doctors, clinical staff and support staff.
* Strong in follow\-up and documentation.
* Capable of maintaining staff discipline without creating unnecessary conflict.

title: Accounts & Finance Manager - On Site
description:
We are looking for an experienced professional to manage our entire project's accounting \& finance with previous 8 to 10 years of expereience of working with construction companies. You will be working directly with the Directors of the company and will be part of senior leadership.

**This position is an on site role and you will be required to stay in the Project's on site Staff Camp or nearby rented accomodation of your choice**. *Please don't apply if this doesn't suit your needs.*

**Role**: To manage and control the day\-to\-day Accounts \& Finance activities at the EPC project site, ensuring accurate accounting, timely financial reporting, project cost monitoring, vendor/subcontractor payments, statutory compliance, cash\-flow management, and effective coordination with the Corporate Finance team and project management.

**Key Responsibilities**

1\. Project Accounting \& Financial Management

* Manage day\-to\-day accounting operations of the project site.
* Ensure proper accounting of project\-related expenses, receipts, advances, and liabilities.
* Review and verify accounting entries, vouchers, invoices, and supporting documents.
* Maintain project\-wise and cost\-centre\-wise accounting records.
* Ensure timely closing of monthly accounts and submission of financial data to Corporate Finance.
* Monitor project expenditure against approved budgets.
* Project Cost Control \& MIS
* Monitor project costs against budget, BOQ, work orders, and approved estimates.
* Prepare project\-wise cost statements and financial MIS.
* Analyse cost variances and highlight significant deviations to the Project Head and Corporate Finance.
* Track committed costs, actual expenditure, provisions, and accruals.
* Support project management in maintaining cost efficiency and profitability.
* Provide financial inputs for project reviews and management meetings.
* Vendor \& Subcontractor Accounting
* Verify vendor and subcontractor bills along with supporting documents.
* Ensure proper accounting and timely processing of bills.
* Monitor vendor/subcontractor advances, recoveries, retention money, deductions, and outstanding balances.
* Reconcile vendor ledgers and resolve discrepancies.
* Coordinate with Procurement, Commercial, Stores, and Project teams for bill certification and payment processing.
* Monitor ageing of vendor and subcontractor outstanding payments.
* Billing \& Receivables
* Coordinate with the Billing/Commercial team for timely submission and accounting of client bills.
* Track client receivables and outstanding amounts.
* Monitor advances received from clients and their adjustment.
* Ensure proper accounting of RA Bills, claims, variations, escalation, and other project\-related receipts.
* Prepare receivable ageing reports and follow up for timely collections.
* Cash \& Bank Management
* Prepare and monitor project cash\-flow requirements.
* Maintain daily/weekly cash and bank position.
* Coordinate with Corporate Finance for fund requirements at the project site.
* Monitor site\-level petty cash and cash advances.
* Perform regular bank reconciliation and resolve outstanding items.
* Ensure proper control over cash disbursements and approvals.
* Statutory Compliance
* Ensure timely compliance with applicable statutory requirements related to the project.
* Coordinate for GST, TDS, PF, ESI, labour\-related deductions, and other applicable statutory matters.
* Verify statutory deductions from vendor/subcontractor bills.
* Maintain proper records and supporting documents for audits and statutory requirements.
* Coordinate with Corporate Tax/Finance teams during assessments, notices, and statutory audits.
* Payroll \& Employee\-Related Finance Activities
* Coordinate with HR/Admin for project payroll\-related accounting requirements.
* Verify payroll\-related provisions, reimbursements, advances, and recoveries.
* Ensure timely accounting of employee expenses and site advances.
* Monitor settlement of employee advances and travel expenses.
* Stores, Inventory \& Fixed Assets
* Coordinate with Stores and Project teams for proper accounting of material receipts, issues, transfers, and consumption.
* Monitor project inventory valuation and reconciliation.
* Ensure proper accounting and documentation of project assets.
* Support periodic physical verification of inventory and fixed assets.
* Monitor capitalisation and depreciation\-related requirements.
* Audit \& Internal Control
* Ensure compliance with company financial policies, SOPs, and internal controls.
* Coordinate with Internal Audit, Statutory Audit, and Corporate Finance teams.
* Provide required schedules, ledgers, vouchers, and supporting documents during audits.
* Identify financial control gaps and implement corrective measures.
* Ensure proper documentation and approval hierarchy for financial transactions.
* Coordination with Project Team
* Work closely with Project Manager, Project Head, Commercial, Procurement, Stores, HR \& Admin, Billing, Planning, and Site Execution teams.
* Provide financial guidance for project\-related commercial and operational decisions.
* Participate in project review meetings and provide financial updates.
* Highlight financial risks, cost overruns, cash\-flow constraints, and commercial issues to management.

**Key Deliverables / KPIs**

* Timely and accurate monthly project accounts.
* Budget vs. actual project cost monitoring.
* Timely vendor and subcontractor bill processing.
* Reduction in outstanding vendor/subcontractor balances.
* Accurate project cash\-flow forecasting.
* Timely client billing and receivable monitoring.
* Timely GST/TDS and other applicable statutory compliance.
* Accurate bank and ledger reconciliation.
* Audit compliance with minimum observations.
* Effective control over project expenses and advances.
* Timely submission of project MIS to Corporate Finance.

Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of project accounting and cost control.
* Good understanding of EPC/Infrastructure project finance.
* Knowledge of GST, TDS, PF, ESI and other applicable statutory requirements.
* Strong analytical and reconciliation skills.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel and accounting/ERP software such as SAP, Oracle, Tally, or equivalent.
* Vendor and subcontractor bill verification experience.
* Good understanding of project cash\-flow management.
* Strong communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to work independently at a project site.
* Strong attention to detail and financial discipline.

description:
Production Executive

**Location:** Coimbatore  
**Department:** Production  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Reports To:** Production Manager / Head of Production  
**Experience:** 2\+ Years

About the Role

We are looking for a **production executive** to support and manage day\-to\-day production operations, ensuring smooth manufacturing processes, optimum manpower utilization, timely production, quality compliance, and effective resource management.

The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience in production planning, shop\-floor management, manpower coordination, material management, production documentation, and process improvement.

Key Responsibilities 1\. Production Planning \& Execution

* Plan and execute daily production activities based on production requirements and schedules.
* Coordinate with the production manager to achieve planned production volumes within the defined timelines.
* Monitor production activities throughout the shift and ensure smooth workflow.
* Allocate manpower and resources effectively based on production requirements.
* Ensure production is carried out according to approved processes, SOPs, and work instructions.
* Monitor production output and immediately report major deviations or delays to the reporting manager.

2\. Shop\-Floor Management

* Supervise day\-to\-day production activities on the shop floor.
* Ensure proper utilization of manpower, machines, materials, and other production resources.
* Monitor employee attendance, productivity, work allocation, and discipline within the production area.
* Ensure proper housekeeping and workplace organization in the production area.
* Identify operational issues and coordinate with the concerned teams for timely resolution.
* Maintain smooth coordination between shifts and ensure proper handover of pending activities.

3\. Manpower Management

* Allocate operators and workers according to production requirements.
* Monitor manpower availability and identify shortages that may affect production.
* Guide and support production staff in performing their assigned activities.
* Train employees on production procedures, SOPs, safety practices, and work instructions.
* Monitor employee performance and communicate recurring issues to the production manager.
* Ensure proper discipline and adherence to company policies within the production area.

4\. Raw Material \& Material Coordination

* Coordinate with stores and purchase teams to ensure timely availability of raw materials, packaging materials, and other production requirements.
* Verify material availability before starting production.
* Monitor material consumption against production requirements.
* Identify material shortages, excess consumption, wastage, or production\-related material issues.
* Ensure proper handling and storage of materials within the production area.
* Coordinate material movement between stores and Production.

5\. Production \& Quality Coordination

* Ensure production activities comply with defined quality standards and approved specifications.
* Coordinate with the Quality team for in\-process inspections and quality checks.
* Identify and report quality deviations during production.
* Support investigation of production\-related quality issues and implementation of corrective actions.
* Ensure rejected, damaged, or non\-conforming materials are properly identified and segregated.
* Follow approved SOPs and quality procedures during production activities.

6\. Machine \& Equipment Coordination

* Monitor the operational condition of production machinery and equipment.
* Coordinate with the maintenance team for machine breakdowns and technical issues.
* Report recurring machine problems that affect production efficiency.
* Ensure machines are operated safely and according to approved operating procedures.
* Support preventive maintenance activities by coordinating production requirements with the maintenance team.
* Ensure proper cleaning and basic upkeep of production equipment.

7\. Production Records \& Documentation

* Maintain accurate daily production records and reports.
* Record production quantity, rejection, wastage, downtime, manpower, and material consumption.
* Ensure proper completion of batch records, production sheets, checklists, and other required documents.
* Maintain shift\-wise production records and handover information.
* Ensure production documentation is complete, accurate, and available for review.
* Support preparation of daily, weekly, and monthly production reports.

8\. Production Reconciliation

* Reconcile planned production against actual production.
* Monitor raw material consumption against production output.
* Identify production variances, wastage, rejection, and process losses.
* Coordinate with Stores and Accounts/Finance teams wherever required for material and production reconciliation.
* Investigate significant variances and report findings to the production manager.

9\. Wastage \& Process Improvement

* Monitor production wastage and identify the reasons for excess wastage.
* Implement approved corrective actions to reduce material and process losses.
* Identify opportunities to improve production efficiency and reduce downtime.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives within the production process.
* Suggest practical improvements in workflow, manpower utilization, material handling, and production processes.

10\. Safety \& Compliance

* Ensure employees follow all applicable production safety procedures.
* Ensure appropriate use of PPE and other safety equipment.
* Report unsafe conditions, accidents, near misses, and safety concerns immediately.
* Maintain a safe and organized production environment.
* Ensure compliance with company SOPs, statutory requirements, and internal production policies.

11\. Cross\-Functional Coordination

* Coordinate with stores for raw material and packaging material requirements.
* Coordinate with Quality for inspections, testing, and quality\-related issues.
* Coordinate with Maintenance for machine breakdowns and preventive maintenance.
* Coordinate with Purchase for material availability and shortages.
* Coordinate with Planning/Sales for production requirements and schedules.
* Coordinate with HR regarding manpower availability, attendance, training, and disciplinary matters.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in **production, mechanical, industrial engineering, manufacturing, or a related field**.
* **2\+ years of experience** in production operations, manufacturing, or a similar role.
* Experience in handling production activities in a manufacturing environment.
* Practical knowledge of production planning and shop\-floor operations.
* Experience in manpower and material coordination.
* Good understanding of production processes, SOPs, quality requirements, and safety practices.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills.

The role also includes participating in requirement\-gathering discussions and ensuring effective follow\-up with prospects to move opportunities through the sales cycle.

4\. Sales Pipeline Management

The candidate will maintain daily activity reports, update CRM records, track opportunities from lead generation to closure, and maintain an accurate sales pipeline.

Regular reporting, forecasting, and achievement of assigned business development targets will be a key part of the role.

5\. Relationship Building

Building long\-term relationships with industrial clients is critical to success in this position. The candidate will participate in industrial exhibitions, trade fairs, networking events, and industry association meetings to expand Bluebenz's market presence.

The role also involves developing referral networks and maintaining strong customer relationships that contribute to repeat business and future opportunities.

6\. Market Intelligence

The candidate will continuously monitor industry trends, competitor activities, and ERP adoption patterns within the manufacturing sector.

Insights gathered from customers and the market should be shared with management to support strategic business decisions and identify emerging opportunities.

**Performance Expectations**

The successful candidate is expected to maintain a strong field presence and consistently generate new business opportunities.

Expected activity levels include conducting approximately 8 to 12 factory visits per day, meeting 4 to 5 decision\-makers daily, adding at least 25 new prospects every week, maintaining a healthy sales pipeline, and contributing to monthly business opportunity generation targets.

Applicants should possess a Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Computer Applications, Engineering, or a related field. An MBA in Marketing or Sales will be considered an added advantage.

**Experience Requirements**

Fresh graduates with strong communication skills, confidence, and a genuine interest in sales are encouraged to apply.

Candidates with 1 to 5 years of experience in ERP Sales, Software Sales, Industrial Sales, Manufacturing Solutions Sales, or B2B Sales will be preferred.

**Skills \& Competencies**

The ideal candidate should possess strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills.

A basic understanding of ERP systems, manufacturing operations, inventory management, production planning, and business software solutions will be advantageous.

The candidate should be self\-motivated, target\-oriented, proactive, and capable of working independently in a field\-sales environment.

**Travel Requirements**

This position requires extensive travel across industrial regions including Pune MIDC, Chakan MIDC, Bhosari MIDC, Ranjangaon MIDC, Talegaon Industrial Area, Pimpri\-Chinchwad Industrial Belt, Satara, Kolhapur, Nashik, Aurangabad, Ahmednagar, and other industrial zones across Maharashtra.

Candidates must possess a two\-wheeler and should be comfortable with frequent local and regional travel.

**Compensation \& Benefits**

In addition to fixed compensation, employees will be eligible for performance\-based incentives, travel allowance, fuel reimbursement, mobile allowance, performance bonuses, and career advancement opportunities.

description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONEXECUTIVE HOUSEKEEPER

**Hotel:** Okean De Goa  
**Department:** Housekeeping  
**Position:** Executive Housekeeper  
**Reports To:** General Manager / Operations Manager  
**Supervises:** Housekeeping Supervisors, Room Attendants, Housepersons, Public Area Attendants, Linen/Laundry Staff and other Housekeeping Team Members  
**Location:** Goa  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

1\. JOB PURPOSE

The Executive Housekeeper is responsible for the overall management and smooth operation of the Housekeeping Department at Okean De Goa.

The position is responsible for maintaining high standards of **cleanliness, hygiene, presentation, guest comfort and room readiness** throughout the hotel. The Executive Housekeeper will lead the housekeeping team, plan daily operations, conduct inspections, control inventory and linen, coordinate with other departments, and ensure that guest rooms and public areas are maintained according to the hotel's standards.

2\. KEY RESPONSIBILITIESA. Housekeeping Operations

* Plan, organize and supervise the day\-to\-day operations of the Housekeeping Department.
* Ensure all guest rooms are cleaned, inspected and released on time for arrivals.
* Monitor departure rooms, stay\-over rooms, vacant rooms and priority rooms.
* Ensure corridors, lobby areas, public areas, staircases, back\-of\-house areas and other hotel premises are maintained properly.
* Prepare and implement daily cleaning schedules and deep\-cleaning schedules.
* Ensure housekeeping operations are properly managed during high\-occupancy periods.
* Coordinate room cleaning priorities according to arrivals, VIP guests, special requests and operational requirements.

B. Room Inspection \& Quality Control

* Conduct regular inspections of guest rooms and public areas.
* Ensure rooms meet Okean De Goa's required standards before releasing them to Front Office.
* Check cleanliness, linen, towels, amenities, bathroom condition, furniture, fixtures, lighting, AC condition and overall room presentation.
* Identify maintenance defects and immediately report them to the Maintenance/Engineering Department.
* Follow up on reported defects until they are resolved.
* Take corrective action whenever housekeeping standards are not maintained.
* Maintain consistent hygiene and cleanliness standards throughout the property.

C. Staff Management

* Supervise and manage the complete Housekeeping team.
* Prepare staff duty rosters, shifts, weekly offs and work allocations.
* Allocate rooms and cleaning duties according to occupancy and workload.
* Monitor staff attendance, grooming, discipline and performance.
* Conduct daily briefings and communicate operational priorities to the team.
* Train new employees on cleaning procedures, hotel standards, hygiene, safety and guest service.
* Conduct regular on\-the\-job training and refresher training.
* Motivate the team and maintain professional discipline within the department.
* Evaluate staff performance and recommend training or corrective action where required.

D. Front Office Coordination

* Maintain close coordination with the Front Office regarding room status.
* Ensure accurate and timely communication of **Vacant Clean, Vacant Dirty, Occupied, Out of Order and Out of Service** room status.
* Prioritize rooms according to expected arrivals and guest requirements.
* Coordinate early\-arrival rooms wherever operationally possible.
* Communicate room readiness to Front Office without unnecessary delay.
* Coordinate with Front Office regarding guest complaints, room changes, special requests and late check\-outs.

E. Linen \& Laundry Management

* Maintain proper control of bed sheets, pillow covers, towels, bath mats, blankets and other hotel linen.
* Maintain minimum and maximum/par stock levels.
* Conduct regular linen inventories and identify shortages or damages.
* Ensure proper handling, storage and movement of clean and soiled linen.
* Monitor laundry quality and turnaround time.
* Ensure damaged or condemned linen is properly recorded.
* Maintain proper records for linen movement and consumption.

F. Housekeeping Supplies \& Inventory

* Maintain adequate stock of cleaning chemicals, guest amenities, toiletries and housekeeping materials.
* Monitor daily consumption and avoid unnecessary wastage.
* Maintain proper housekeeping store records.
* Prepare purchase requisitions when stock reaches the required reorder level.
* Check the quality and quantity of supplies received.
* Ensure all chemicals and cleaning products are properly labelled, stored and handled safely.
* Maintain control over housekeeping equipment such as vacuum cleaners, mops, trolleys, cleaning machines and other tools.

G. Guest Service \& Complaints

* Ensure prompt response to guest requests related to housekeeping.
* Handle cleanliness\-related guest complaints professionally and ensure proper resolution.
* Coordinate room changes and additional cleaning requirements when necessary.
* Ensure VIP/special occasion rooms are prepared as per instructions.
* Maintain guest privacy and confidentiality at all times.
* Ensure Lost \& Found procedures are strictly followed and all items are recorded and handed over as per hotel policy.

H. Hygiene, Safety \& Security

* Ensure compliance with hotel hygiene and sanitation standards.

**Associate — HR, Admin \& Client Success** Telosa · Baner, Pune · On\-site, 5 days/week · Full\-time · 1\+ year experience Reports to: Founder \& CEO

**About Telosa**

Telosa is an AI\-powered customer experience platform for multi\-location brands — reputation, listings, lead capture, AI resolution and marketing in one dashboard. We work with enterprise clients across India, MENA and Southeast Asia. Small team, fast decisions, direct exposure to how a company gets built.

**The role**

This is the founder's support role for everything that keeps the company running — people, office, compliance — plus the coordination behind client renewals and the quality of what leaves Telosa in writing. It suits someone early in their career who is organised, versatile, and wants range rather than a narrow lane. You will learn by sitting close to the founder and being the person things route through.

**What you'll do**

*Human Resources*

* Coordinate hiring: post roles, source through portals and consultants, do first\-level screening calls, schedule interviews, and follow up with candidates through offer and joining.
* Run onboarding — documentation, appointment letters, induction, asset handover, first\-week experience — and handle exits with the same care.
* Maintain employee records, attendance and leave data; prepare the monthly payroll input for the founder's review.
* Keep HR policy documents current and be the first point of contact for everyday employee queries.
* Organise team events, the festival and birthday calendar, and review scheduling.

*Administration \& Office*

* Run the Baner office day to day: facilities, housekeeping, IT assets, supplies, vendor coordination and AMC renewals.
* Track statutory and compliance paperwork, registrations, insurance and licence renewals; coordinate with the CA and external consultants.
* Process invoices, reimbursements and petty cash; support finance on collections follow\-up.
* Arrange travel, accommodation and visa paperwork for the team.

*Client Renewals — coordination*

* Maintain the master contract tracker: every client, value, renewal date and notice period, always current.
* Flag renewals 60–90 days ahead and pull together the account's usage and outcome data with the customer success and product teams, so the founder walks in prepared.
* Push renewal documentation through to signature and track receivables against it.
* Raise early warning signs — client gone quiet, delayed payment, dropped usage.

*External Communications*

* Draft and manage correspondence going out under the founder's name: client and partner follow\-ups, meeting notes, action trackers, investor update inputs.
* Manage the founder's calendar and prepare briefing notes ahead of external meetings.
* Own the shared inboxes and coordinate outbound comms with the marketing team.
* Keep decks, proposals and templates versioned and presentable.

**What we're looking for**

* 1\+ year of experience in HR, executive assistance, business operations, client servicing or a similar coordination role. Strong internship experience counts.
* High ownership. Chases things to closure without reminders, keeps confidences, and holds several unrelated threads in a day without dropping any.
* Genuinely strong written English. You will be drafting on behalf of the founder; the writing has to land without correction.
* Graduate in any discipline; an MBA/PGDM in HR is welcome but not required.
* Comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets, PowerPoint and business email, and quick to pick up new tools.
* Presentable and composed with senior external stakeholders — clients, investors, partners, vendors.

**Nice to have**

* Exposure to payroll, statutory compliance or contract administration.
* Experience in a B2B SaaS, startup or agency environment.

**What you get**

* A direct line to the founder and visibility into every part of the business — hiring, clients, fundraising, operations. Rare at this stage of a career.
* Real ownership from month one, not a filing job.
* Compensation as per experience.
* Baner, Pune. On\-site, Monday to Friday.

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Quality Control Assistant (QC Assistant)

**Department:** Quality Control  
**Designation:** Quality Control Assistant  
**Reporting To:** QC Officer / QC Executive / QC Manager  
**Industry:** Pharmaceutical / API Manufacturing  
**Experience:** 0–3 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Location:** turbhe

1\. Job Purpose

To support routine Quality Control activities including sampling, testing, documentation, laboratory housekeeping, and maintenance of laboratory records in accordance with **GMP, GLP, approved SOPs, specifications, and company quality standards**.

2\. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Laboratory Testing

* Assist in routine testing of **raw materials, intermediates, APIs, finished products, and other samples** as per approved specifications and SOPs.
* Perform basic chemical and physical analysis under the supervision of senior QC personnel.
* Prepare samples, reagents, solutions, and standards as required.
* Record test results accurately in laboratory worksheets, registers, and analytical records.
* Inform the senior QC personnel immediately of any abnormal or unexpected results.

B. Sampling

* Assist in sampling of raw materials, packing materials, intermediates, and finished products as per approved sampling procedures.
* Ensure proper labeling and identification of samples.
* Maintain sample traceability and transfer samples to the laboratory as per procedures.

C. Laboratory Documentation

* Maintain analytical worksheets, logbooks, registers, and other QC records.
* Follow **Good Documentation Practices (GDP)** while recording laboratory activities.
* Ensure all entries are accurate, legible, complete, and traceable.
* Maintain records of reagent and standard preparation, usage, and expiry.

D. Instruments \& Equipment

* Assist in operation of laboratory instruments under supervision.
* Ensure instruments are clean and properly maintained.
* Record equipment usage and maintain instrument logbooks.
* Inform senior personnel about equipment malfunction or abnormal performance.
* Support calibration and preventive maintenance activities.

E. Reagents \& Solutions

* Prepare laboratory reagents, volumetric solutions, buffers, and other solutions as per approved procedures.
* Properly label all prepared solutions with preparation date, expiry/retest date, and other required details.
* Maintain records of preparation and standardization where applicable.
* Ensure expired or unsuitable reagents are identified and disposed of according to procedures.

F. GMP / GLP Compliance

* Follow applicable **GMP, GLP, SOPs, safety requirements, and laboratory procedures**.
* Maintain cleanliness and housekeeping of the laboratory.
* Ensure proper handling, storage, and disposal of chemicals and laboratory waste.
* Report any deviation, abnormal observation, or safety concern to the supervisor.

G. Stability \& Retention Samples

* Assist in collection, labeling, storage, and retrieval of stability samples.
* Maintain stability sample records and storage conditions.
* Assist in management of retention samples as per approved procedures.

H. Audit \& Inspection Support

* Support preparation of laboratory documents and records for internal audits, customer audits, and regulatory inspections.
* Ensure laboratory records are readily available and properly maintained.
* Assist in addressing routine audit observations under the guidance of senior QC personnel.

3\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Accuracy and completeness of analytical records.
* Timely completion of assigned testing activities.
* Compliance with GMP/GLP and SOP requirements.
* Proper maintenance of laboratory records and logbooks.
* Correct preparation and labeling of reagents and solutions.
* Laboratory housekeeping and safety compliance.
* Proper handling and traceability of samples.

4\. Educational Qualification

**Essential:**

* B.Sc. / M.Sc. in **Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Chemistry, or a related field**.

**Preferred:**

* B.Pharm / Diploma in Pharmacy or relevant laboratory qualification.
* Basic knowledge of analytical laboratory practices.

5\. Experience

* **0–3 years of relevant experience** in Quality Control / Analytical Laboratory in a pharmaceutical, API, chemical, or related manufacturing industry.
* Freshers with relevant educational qualifications may also be considered.

6\. Technical Knowledge

* Basic knowledge of pharmaceutical/API analysis.
* Understanding of laboratory safety practices.
* Basic knowledge of:
* pH meter
* Analytical balance
* UV\-Visible spectrophotometer
* HPLC/GC – basic exposure preferred
* Karl Fischer – basic exposure preferred
* Melting point / physical testing equipment
* Knowledge of GMP, GLP, GDP, and laboratory SOPs.

7\. Required Competencies

* Attention to detail
* Good laboratory practices
* Accuracy in documentation
* Basic analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Good communication skills
* Teamwork
* Time management
* Willingness to learn
* Safety\-conscious approach
* Quality\-focused mindset

8\. Reporting \& Coordination

**Reports To:** QC Officer / QC Executive / QC Manager

**Coordinates With:**  
Quality Assurance \| Production \| Warehouse \| R\&D \| Engineering \| EHS

9\. Overall Responsibility

The **Quality Control Assistant** is responsible for supporting laboratory testing, sampling, documentation, equipment handling, reagent preparation, and other QC activities while ensuring compliance with **GMP, GLP, approved SOPs, specifications, safety requirements, and company quality standards**.

* Monitor manufacturing and packing activities to ensure compliance with approved SOPs and GMP requirements.

* Check line clearance before commencement of manufacturing/packing activities.
* Monitor critical process parameters and in\-process activities.
* Verify equipment status, area cleanliness, environmental conditions, and material status.
* Report and escalate GMP deviations and quality issues to the QA supervisor/manager.

B. Batch Documentation

* Review BMRs, BPRs, logbooks, checklists, and other manufacturing documents for completeness and accuracy.

* Verify material status labels and storage conditions.
* Coordinate with QC for sample submission and testing.

E. Document Control

* Issue and control SOPs, formats, logbooks, and other controlled documents.
* Ensure obsolete documents are withdrawn from use.
* Maintain controlled\-copy records as applicable.

F. Audit \& Inspection Support

* Support preparation for internal audits, customer audits, and regulatory inspections.
* Participate in GMP audits and inspections.

G. Training

* Participate in GMP, SOP, GDP, data integrity, and other quality\-related training.
* Support training of production and QA personnel on applicable SOPs.
* Maintain training records and ensure completion within defined timelines.

H. Validation \& Qualification Support

* Assist QA in review and execution of validation and qualification activities.
* Support review of protocols and reports related to equipment qualification, process validation, cleaning validation, and other validation activities.
* Ensure activities are performed according to approved protocols.

3\. Daily QA Activities

* Perform manufacturing area/shop\-floor checks.
* Verify line clearance.
* Review manufacturing documentation.
* Check equipment and area status.
* Monitor GMP compliance.
* Verify material/product status.
* Record and report deviations.
* Coordinate with Production and QC on quality\-related issues.
* Ensure proper documentation and data integrity.

* Timely completion of batch record review.

* Accuracy of QA documentation.

**Essential:**
